title: Envoys
line: I demand you give me an honorable...

title: Envoys
line: Are you f***ing kidding me? No! Stop that.

line: Whoo, what a day! Man, that escort mission kind of went off the rails, huh?

title: Envoys
line: Sure did.

title: Envoys
line: Can't believe I didn't realize that was a Ferengi in the park. Hey, er... so do you think maybe, maybe, fun idea, we could just keep it between us?

title: Envoys
line: For sure. We're in a circle of trust. This is a shuttle of silence.

title: Envoys
line: So the Ferengi's right there, and I'm like, "Mariner, we can't trust this guy. He's a Ferengi". And then she says, she says, get this, she says, "Oh, no, that's a Bolian". Bolian!

line: Okay, okay. Yep, yep, all right.

line: After this long day of being a badass, Captain Know-It-All over here doesn't even know what a Ferengi was.

title: Envoys
line: "Myah, myah, hyoo-mon!" He was doing the hand thing and everything.

title: Envoys
line: All right, yeah, no, that's my cue to go just launch myself out an air lock. You guys have a great night.

title: Envoys
line: Tendi, I'm sorry. I tried to make it work in another division. I just couldn't do it. I belong in the tubes. I'm not gonna be able to watch the pulsar with you.

title: Envoys
line: All right, whatever. I'll just watch it in there with you on my PADD.

line: Nah, I just wanted company. I mean, it's not like you were trying all those new jobs just to hang with me, right?

title: Envoys
line: No, yeah, no. Could you imagine?

title: Envoys
line: Ah, Mariner, was I convincing enough for you, "hyoo-mon"?

line: Wow. Isn't it amazing?

line: I'm sorry, Captain Freeman, but we're moving the peace negotiations to Vulcan. Nobody wants to go to Cardassia Prime. The Cardassians are creeping everyone out.

line: Seems like they just changed locations. I don't think it was a slight on the Cerritos.

line: Shut up, Jack! I'm sick of it. We have to do something to prove that this crew isn't a bunch of slackers.

line: Field strength is at.

line: Ooh!

line: Wait, don't we have to report that we're done so we can get a new task?

line: Aw, Tendi, look at us. Lower Decks, breaching protocol together. Friendship!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Oh, be sure to stroll through the ship as slowly as possible. It's not like we're busy exploring the mysteries of the cosmos!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Does no one do any work around here?!

line: Geez, there goes buffer time.

line: What was that, Ensign?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Er, nothing, Captain.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Oh...

line: Bridge.

line: Cap'n. I mean, Captain.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Anything to report, Ensign?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Er, keeping busy. I inventoried Cargo Bay Four, assisted with the baryon sweep of the warp nacelles, skipped buffer time and went straight to work on...

title: Temporal Edict
line: Turbolift halt! What is buffer time?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Er...

title: Temporal Edict
line: What's up with you? You're looking more, like, weaselly than usual.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Well, th... that's just how my face looks. You... you know that.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Oh. Effective immediately, the Lower Deck scheduling deceit will no longer be tolerated? What scheduling deceit?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Wait. Lemme see. All assignments must be completed and logged in exactly the time mandated by command?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Are we being timed?

title: Temporal Edict
line: Failure to meet quotas will not be tolerated. Ah, this is bad, this is bad.

title: Temporal Edict
line: I thought it was tradition. I thought you said nobody cared.

title: Temporal Edict
line: They didn't. There was no way the captain noticed we were padding stuff out. Somebody ratted. Oh, I bet it was Delta shift.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Yeah. Delta shift is the worst. They think they're so much better than us, just because they're so much better than us.

title: Temporal Edict
line: It doesn't matter who ratted. We don't need buffer time. We're Starfleet. We're the best of the best, and we can still get everything done early.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Boimler's right. We don't need a buffer time. We've got this!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Yeah, no, yeah, you're probably right. What's one less margarita a day?

line: Excuse me!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Watch it.

line: But now is right now! Move! Move, move, move, move!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Aah! Come on, watch where you're going.

line: Now I only have ten minutes to do a 30-minute calibration.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Stop yelling!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Er, sorry, wish I could help. I'm late for Ransom's stupid away mission.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Ensign Tendi! You were supposed to be in sickbay 20 minutes ago!

title: Temporal Edict
line: I'm coming! Ooo, somebody's got to purge the calibration matrix. I call dibs!

title: Temporal Edict
line: Ooo, I love purging. I purge you, I purge you, I purge you. I purge, purge, purge, purge, purge, purge, purge. And a P and a urge and a P and a urge. Ooo, I love purging.

title: Temporal Edict
line: All right, let's see a little hustle there, guys. An away mission is only routine until it isn't. Horned gorillas, sentient tar, spores that make you hook up with your best friend's sister. All disasters I've personally experienced on missions that should have been a walk in the park. Mariner, you're late.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Er, no, I've been here the whole time, you know, loading stuff, hearing about gorillas, er, spores, et cetera. That weird story you told us about your best friend's sister.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Get it together, Mariner. The captain has us on a strict timetable.

title: Temporal Edict
line: Well then, maybe you could help instead of whatever you're doing right now.

title: Temporal Edict
line: I am helping. I'm commanding. You're lucky your phaser accuracy is so high, or I'd never let you beam off this ship.

title: Temporal Edict
line: We wouldn't even be going on a mission if the admiral hadn't downgraded the captain to delivering gifts. Come on, let's bail.

title: Temporal Edict
line: No. And roll down those sleeves. This isn't a barn.

line: The Gelrakians base their entire social structure around crystals. When we land, we must display the honor crystal they gave to the first contact team to show that we come in peace. I should've tried that with my ex.

line: Yeah.

line: Urgh.

line: I'm picking up an increase in atmospheric hydromounds.

line: Yeah, they're called clouds, man.

line: I didn't catch that, Mariner.

line: Er, yeah I just said we should get going, clock is ticking. Er, productivity and et cetera.

line: We'll go when I give the order. Let's roll.

line: Red alert! Repel all intruders, but do not use it as an excuse to stop doing what you are doing. I want to stay on track and on time. It's called multi-tasking, people. line: Swords and spears? How did these guys get on board?

line: Hey, guy. Hey, guy? Hey, guy, is this what you wanted to do with your life? Just capture people? Is that what you dreamt of when you were a little whatever-you-are? Are you fulfilled by that?

line: All right, you know what you've got going on? You have broad shoulders and shiny hair and you talk a good game, but when it comes to actually doing the job... the job... you don't have it. I'm calling bull**** on your whole thing here, sir.

line: You're so busy breaking protocol that you never look ahead. One of these days you're going to get someone killed, Ensign.

line: Yeah, but I... I have a phaser. These guys are lightweights. This is what the red alert's about?

line: Intruder! Oh, it's just that huffy ensign. Sorry, Brimler.

line: Why aren't you at your post? We wouldn't even be in this situation if you weren't slacking off.

line: I'm not!

line: Damn it! We're 15 minutes behind. Our entire schedule is going to be off for the month.

line: Wait a minute. Clocks, time, schedules. You guys are under the strict scheduling, too?

line: I need us working harder and faster and stricter!

line: Trial by combat is my responsibility. I'm ranking officer, I'll be fighting Vindor, end of story!

line: You know what, I do get off on breaking protocol. I'm good at exploring strange new worlds, solving space mysteries and kicking asses. line: You know I don't have any.

line: Because you play it safe. You said it. That's our team under that geode. Let me do what I'm good at. Let me save them. Sometimes you have to do what's wrong to survive.

line: You're right.

line: Argh! What the?! Ah, God, oh! You stabbed me in the foot with a battle blade!

line: I'd rather die than let you put your life on the line.

line: Oh, you are such a psycho! What are you doing? Ow! Why?

line: I'm the First Officer of a Federation starship, and your commander. And nobody crushes my team. Let's do this!

line: Ha-ha-ha! Yah! Ha-ha! Double-fist punch! Oh!

line: Whoa, that was actually kind of hot. Ugh! Get it together, Mariner, get it together. You are not into this. Come on.

line: Let's see how much those Federation wood lovers like our crystal graffiti. Ha-ha-ha!

line: I... I need to get back to comms.

line: Don't touch me! This is all my fault, thinking I belong at a peace summit when I can't even keep my own ship together.

line: What? Captain, no. You did nothing wrong. Your schedules, your rules... this has been the greatest week of my life. You run the tightest ship in Starfleet.

line: Tightest ship. Then why is it falling apart?

line: Because not everyone is a Boimler. This crew has their limits. They're only human. Well, and Vulcan. And Orion. There's that Benzite guy in Tactical.

line: Damn it, man! If you're trying to inspire some sort of resolution, then inspire it now!

line: Ugh, it kills me to say this, but for the good of the ship we have to... loosen up.

line: Captain's log. The Cerritos is finishing second contact duties on Apergos. On a personal note, my daughter has yet another side mission request. When I agreed to give her more autonomy, I never realized how often I would be catering to her whims. It's getting a bit old.

line: Ha. No, I don't care about that. I'm worried about SMD. Synthetic Memory Degradation. It's a rare condition that affects cyborgs with new implants. First your opinions change, then your brain liquifies and melts out of your nose. Luckily, this is exactly what I've been training for. I will save my friend.

line: The Pakleds appear to have Klingon weaponry. Primary shields are failing.

title: wej Duj
line: Captain, the project I have been working on is a regenerative shield amplifier. I believe it may help.

title: wej Duj
line: This has not been tested. If it damages the coupling, we would be left unprotected.

title: wej Duj
line: It is logical to use it now, considering there are no alternatives. My instinct tells me it will work.

title: wej Duj
line: Implement the program.

title: wej Duj
line: Yes, yes. The destruction of two enemy ships will bring me much glory.

title: wej Duj
line: These are not our enemies. Does the High Council know of your actions?

title: wej Duj
line: The High Council lacks foresight. They will change their minds when the battle begins.

title: wej Duj
line: The shields are... increasing. This is highly improbable, Captain. They are now at 120%.

title: wej Duj
line: Disable the Pakled ship.

title: wej Duj
line: Target the Federation ship.

title: wej Duj
line: Belay that order.

title: wej Duj
line: What?

title: wej Duj
line: This is not our fight. This lunacy must end.

title: wej Duj
line: Ha. You dare challenge me?

title: wej Duj
line: Stop the attack.

title: wej Duj
line: Finish them.

title: wej Duj
line: No.

title: wej Duj
line: Stupid targ.

title: wej Duj
line: Ah.

title: wej Duj
line: What are your orders, Captain?

title: wej Duj
line: Set a course for the homeworld. The Council can decide what to do with this biHnuch.

title: wej Duj
line: Captain, the Klingon ship is retreating.

title: wej Duj
line: Well then, let's give the Pakleds a taste of their own mushfroot.

title: wej Duj
line: Yes, sir.

title: wej Duj
line: Hail the Vulcans. Thanks for the hand, Captain. For a minute there, we were in a little over our...

title: wej Duj
line: Do you require assistance?

title: wej Duj
line: I think we're okay over here. We were just...

title: wej Duj
line: Excellent. Then with the threat neutralized, no further communication is necessary.

title: wej Duj
line: Well, isn't he a ton of fun? Assess the damage. Let's begin repairs. Klingons helping Pakleds? Well, I guess now we know how they got all those weapons.

title: wej Duj
line: Strange how they broke off and retreated, though. Klingons typically want to die in battle. Honestly, I get it.

title: wej Duj
line: It's almost like they decided it wasn't their fight.

title: wej Duj
line: Captain?

title: wej Duj
line: We need to brief Starfleet Command. They're gonna have a lot to discuss with the Klingon High Council.

title: wej Duj
line: We are fortunate that your shield program worked. If you had not been following your instinct, it is unlikely we would have survived that encounter.

title: wej Duj
line: I concur.

title: wej Duj
line: However, your inability to control your emotions is a liability. I am removing you from duty.

title: wej Duj
line: Captain, I believe you are making an error.

title: wej Duj
line: Your perceived victory today will only serve as fuel for further impulsivity. There is no place for that on this starship.

title: wej Duj
line: I will gather my personal items and prepare to return to Vulcan.

title: wej Duj
line: You will not be returning to Vulcan.

title: wej Duj
line: Curious.

title: wej Duj
line: I am recommending you for reassignment... to a Starfleet vessel. Your hotheaded ways may make you better suited to serve with humans.

title: wej Duj
line: Captain, I ask that you reconsider. I do not believe this punishment is warranted.

title: wej Duj
line: And that is exactly the type of outburst which led to my decision. It is final.

title: wej Duj
line: Live long and prosper. Sir.

title: wej Duj
line: They're all from moons. Look at them, probably talking about tides and werewolves. I was so close. Argh.

title: wej Duj
line: I know you really wanted to have a bridge buddy, but guess what? You don't need them... you've got us. Next time we have a long-haul warp, I vote we all do something together, cool?

title: wej Duj
line: You know it.

title: wej Duj
line: Cool.

title: wej Duj
line: You're right. Thanks, guys. I appreciate it.

title: wej Duj
line: Excuse me? Ensign Boimler, sir?

title: wej Duj
line: Huh? Yeah, er, yeah, that's me.

title: wej Duj
line: Well, I've been having trouble keeping up with my duty schedule. Commander Ransom said that you're the most organized person on the ship.

title: wej Duj
line: He did?

title: wej Duj
line: Yeah, he says you're great, and I should pick your brain, if that's okay.

title: wej Duj
line: I mean, yes. Of course. Yeah, glad to help. Sure.

title: wej Duj
line: Oh, thank you, sir. I really admire your work.

title: wej Duj
line: Let's talk duties. Every ship in the fleet depends on officers like us to keep them running. The bridge crew is maybe the ones you hear about, but trust me, the real action begins on the lower decks.

title: First First Contact
line: Captain's log, stardate 58130.6. The Cerritos has rendezvoused with the Archimedes and my old friend Captain Sonya Gomez so that we can assist in her first contact of the Lapeerians.

title: First First Contact
line: The Laap System is fairly unassuming. A gas giant, couple Class Js, obviously our new Class M, and an unstable planetoid right here, just off its ecliptic.

title: First First Contact
line: The Cerritos will be positioned outside the system.

title: First First Contact
line: Isn't that overly cautious for a planetoid?

title: First First Contact
line: Carol, I know Cali-class isn't afraid of getting their nacelles dirty. We just don't want multiple ships approaching at once, or the Lapeerians might mistake first contact for a first invasion.

title: First First Contact
line: Of course.

title: First First Contact
line: Once formalities are complete, the Cerritos can install subspace transponders and join us for a celebration with the locals.

title: First First Contact
line: I'll tell sickbay to brace for hangovers.

title: First First Contact
line: One more thing, Captain Freeman. I've heard that congratulations are in order.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, great. Jennifer. I'm sure you just love catching me with contraband, but can you try not to rat me out to Ransom this time, okay?

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah, I don't care.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, please, I know you hate me.

title: First First Contact
line: Pfft. I don't think about you at all.

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah, right. I bet you dream about me every night with your stupid little butt... Whoa.

title: First First Contact
line: Enjoy your final mission on the Cerritos. New ships are exciting, but trust me, you'll miss your crew.

title: First First Contact
line: You don't think the Admiralty will let me transfer my senior staff?

title: First First Contact
line: With California-class? Command likes to keep a real sense of consistency. You're gonna have to make some tearful goodbyes.

title: First First Contact
line: Aw, man, this again? Hey, Boimler, my implant's messing up my vision. Can you take my shift in Cetacean Ops so I can get it fixed?

title: First First Contact
line: Sorry, I can't. Captain Freeman Day's only a week away. My decorations have to be the best.

title: First First Contact
line: Isn't that a craft day for toddlers?

title: First First Contact
line: Not anymore.

title: First First Contact
line: Hey. I. I was just hiding behind a bush and I heard the captain's getting a promotion.

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa, really? Good for her.

title: First First Contact
line: Bad for us! I don't want a whole new captain. We could end up with some weirdo with a riding crop.

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah, but this is huge for your mom. She gets to dive into the unknown on a whole new ship. Gah, I never get to dive into unknowns.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, a promotion means a big party and a fancy dinner. I hope it's fajitas.

title: First First Contact
line: Ooo, ooo, ooo, then we get to line up in the hallway, right? And then we all applaud while the captain walks off the ship for the last time.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, that sounds great!

title: First First Contact
line: It sounds like betrayal, but with clapping.

title: First First Contact
line: Urgh, this is totally going to ruin the timing for Captain Freeman Day. You think Ransom might be willing to move it up?

title: First First Contact
line: It is a vanity holiday to trick kids into respecting authority, plus she hasn't even told Ransom... And he'd probably be super pissed. Ah. Thanks, Boimler!

title: First First Contact
line: Mariner, no. Mariner! Ah! That wasn't my idea!

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, no. Doctor T'Ana wants to see me in her office. I think she's mad at me.

title: First First Contact
line: For what?

title: First First Contact
line: Well, I mean, there's just so much to study on the Cerritos, sometimes it's hard to stay focused on just sickbay.

title: First First Contact
line: Come on. Doctor T's grouchy, and you're great. I'm sure you're overthinking it.

title: First First Contact
line: Ah, thank you, Rutherford.

title: First First Contact
line: You're welcome. Well, I guess I'll head off. You don't think this alert will mess with my work, do you?

title: First First Contact
line: Hello? Tendi?

title: First First Contact
line: She says hi to everyone. She's a waitress.

title: First First Contact
line: But it's different. She's, like, so attentive. I mean, always asking what I'm doing...

title: First First Contact
line: Yo, what's up? Talking about bridge crew stuff? Tough gig, tough gig.

title: First First Contact
line: Er, this booth's full, Ensign.

title: First First Contact
line: I get it, yeah, I know, and you want to maintain the illusion of command, yeah.

title: First First Contact
line: It's not an illusion. I'm your commander.

title: First First Contact
line: Sure. I'll take off, but first, I think I have something that you guys are going to want to hear. Yeah, so I was on the station...

title: First First Contact
line: We'll see you in the Laap system, Captain Freeman.

title: First First Contact
line: Looking forward to it, Captain Gomez. Ransom, take us out.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, is it time to go? Thank you so much for all that information, Captain.

title: First First Contact
line: Okay... Shaxs, any update on those phaser repairs?

title: First First Contact
line: No. And if there was an update, I would tell you. I wouldn't keep that information to myself. I'm an open book.

title: First First Contact
line: Did someone buy an alien mood-altering plant on the station or something?

title: First First Contact
line: Maybe everyone feels like they should know more about what's going on on the ship. Like need-to-know stuff that they don't know, you know?

title: First First Contact
line: The Cerritos is ready for warp, Captain. You know, your ship?

title: First First Contact
line: Oh. Just warp me already. Senior staff, in my ready room, now.

title: First First Contact
line: Look, at this point, it's pretty f*****g clear she's not cut out for Medical.

title: First First Contact
line: What? No!

title: First First Contact
line: What the hell is going on here?

title: First First Contact
line: I heard you and Gomez, back on the station.

title: First First Contact
line: Heard what?

title: First First Contact
line: That you're being offered a promotion to a new ship, and while I can assume I'll remain at your side, everyone else here is pretty upset.

title: First First Contact
line: Who said I'm taking you with me?

title: First First Contact
line: You aren't?

title: First First Contact
line: So you are leaving? Why didn't you tell us? You're lucky I'm so spiritually centered or I'd snap!

title: First First Contact
line: It's not official.

title: First First Contact
line: Why the hell wouldn't you take your number one? I agree with you at all times!

title: First First Contact
line: I would transfer all of you if I could, but Command doesn't like shuffling crews off California-cla...

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, that's such f*****g bulls**t! We are just as good as any other f*****g class! Our warp core is twice as f****g fast as any other ship in the fleet!

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa! Mister Billups...

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, hey. So who's going to be the new captain?

title: First First Contact
line: Come on, who else would it be?

title: First First Contact
line: They'll be bringing on someone new.

title: First First Contact
line: What?!

title: First First Contact
line: This is ridiculous!

title: First First Contact
line: Are you serious?

title: First First Contact
line: Rutherford!

title: First First Contact
line: Hey! How'd it go with Doctor T?

title: First First Contact
line: I didn't talk to her. I think she's going to transfer me.

title: First First Contact
line: From Medical?

title: First First Contact
line: No! Off the ship! I saw her delete me from the system.

title: First First Contact
line: What? No way! That's crazy! You're, like, the nicest person in sickbay.

title: First First Contact
line: I don't think that Doctor T'Ana cares about being nice. She's more into hostility. Oh! I should've been more mean!

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. I gotta see this for myself. Hang on. You're right. You're not in there! That's so unfair.

title: First First Contact
line: I can't believe this. I'll miss the Cerritos so much.

title: First First Contact
line: Then let's make sure you see her one last time. Come on.

title: First First Contact
line: What do you mean?

title: First First Contact
line: Let's go visit all your favorite places on the ship, so you can have a proper goodbye.

title: First First Contact
line: That's a great idea.

title: First First Contact
line: Ow!

title: First First Contact
line: Er, maybe I should lead the way.

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah, that's an okey dokey from me.

title: First First Contact
line: All scans nominal, Captain Gomez. Welcome to the Laap system.

title: First First Contact
line: Take us in nice and slow. Let's give them plenty of time to scan us. Nobody likes unexpected guests.

title: First First Contact
line: Ah! Er, I'm okay. Please don't, it's fine.

title: First First Contact
line: Don't worry about it. I've done way worse in front of much more intimidating captains.

title: First First Contact
line: Ah. Maintenance hatch 7-88, always warm to the touch. Ow!

title: First First Contact
line: Little ship, but a big warp core. Oh, listen to that thrum.

title: First First Contact
line: Ah!

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa.

title: First First Contact
line: This is where we watched the Trivoli pulsar. They always tell you not to get too attached to your ship, but how could you not?

title: First First Contact
line: Hey, can I tell you something?

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah?

title: First First Contact
line: I am attached to the ship. I love the Cerritos. I have for a long time now, and no one can tell me otherwise!

title: First First Contact
line: I love the Cerritos, too.

title: First First Contact
line: Ooo, I know where we should go next. Somewhere off-limits.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh. The rubber ducky room?

title: First First Contact
line: Better.

title: First First Contact
line: Not fair! Not fair! That job is mine! That job is mine!

title: First First Contact
line: Enough! Look. Your complaints are noted. Now get back to your stations.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, come on.

title: First First Contact
line: Except you. What were you thinking? I was going to tell them at the right time. I was trying to avoid conflict.

title: First First Contact
line: That's super messed up. Those are your friends.

title: First First Contact
line: A captain can't worry about feelings when it comes to a decision like this.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh. Well then, you're in luck, because you don't have feelings.

title: First First Contact
line: Gosh, you've got so much to learn.

title: First First Contact
line: Report.

title: First First Contact
line: The Lapeerian sun just emitted an unpredicted flare. It's headed straight for that planetoid!

title: First First Contact
line: All right. Give me the bad news.

title: First First Contact
line: Magnetized ionic plasma in those fragments overloaded the ship's systems. It's like we were hit with an EMP. Warp core's off-line.

title: First First Contact
line: What about reserves?

title: First First Contact
line: Backup power cells are down. Captain, it's all down.

title: First First Contact
line: But... we're still moving?

title: First First Contact
line: Momentum, plus the Lapeerian gravity well.

title: First First Contact
line: But that means...

title: First First Contact
line: Unless we figure something out, first contact is going to be us crashing into that planet. Okay, that's enough existential dread. Let's get back to work.

title: First First Contact
line: The Archimedes took a full hit. Her engines are down.

title: First First Contact
line: That planetoid was stuffed with radiolytic isotopes.

title: First First Contact
line: They're caught in the gravity well. Twenty hours until impact. Planetary damage... it'll be catastrophic.

title: First First Contact
line: If we can get a tractor beam on them...

title: First First Contact
line: Not going to happen, Captain. That debris is caught in the orbit, too. If a piece as small as a pomegranate hit our shields, the reaction would knock out our systems.

title: First First Contact
line: Hold on. What about the deflector? I mean, isn't that its whole job, to deflect?

title: First First Contact
line: If we project any sort of energy field, it'll draw the plasma right to us.

title: First First Contact
line: Can't we just warp past the debris?

title: First First Contact
line: That was merely a suggestion.

title: First First Contact
line: Just break the rules. There has to be something we can do, right?

title: First First Contact
line: I... I don't know.

title: First First Contact
line: Argh!

title: First First Contact
line: The captain's yacht? Mom, that's not going to work. It's got the same shielding as the Cerritos.

title: First First Contact
line: Voice authorisation, Freeman.

title: First First Contact
line: If I can navigate through the debris...

title: First First Contact
line: You haven't piloted anything in years.

title: First First Contact
line: Please. I've still got the hydroscoot record back at the Academy.

title: First First Contact
line: This isn't a hydroscoot! You know what? I'll do it.

title: First First Contact
line: No! Off my yacht!

title: First First Contact
line: Do you think they always come here to fight? Maybe that's why it's off-limits.

title: First First Contact
line: I don't know, but look at all this ionic plasma. This is bad.

title: First First Contact
line: What are you trying to prove? You already got the f*****g promotion.

title: First First Contact
line: Get off my yacht! That's an order!

title: First First Contact
line: To let you get killed? Er, no way. I won't give you the satisfaction.

title: First First Contact
line: I'm trying to save lives. You can't just bully your way into whatever you want. Why do you act like this?

title: First First Contact
line: Because I'm a Kirk-style free spirit who kicks butt and it super-intimidates people. You know that. That's why you've always protected me from getting court-martialed.

title: First First Contact
line: You're not a Kirk. Kirk was confident.

title: First First Contact
line: So am I!

title: First First Contact
line: You used to be. But now the only thing you're confident of is that everything has to be a fight. You have to drop your defenses and make some allies.

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa!

title: First First Contact
line: Rutherford! Were you... were you spying on us?

title: First First Contact
line: I think I know how to save the Archimedes. We have to drop our defenses, like how Mariner has to do with people.

title: First First Contact
line: Ah, you heard that, huh?

title: First First Contact
line: Even if we lower our shields, the hull itself has magnetic shielding. There's no way to discharge it.

title: First First Contact
line: Yes. So we remove the hull.

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa.

title: First First Contact
line: Okay, er, we do kind of need that to, you know, like, protect us from the vacuum of space.

title: First First Contact
line: That's the inner hull. The outer is an extra layer of protection...

title: First First Contact
line: Which we wouldn't need, because we aren't even going to warp.

title: First First Contact
line: Wait, you guys aren't seriously talking about stripping the ship.

title: First First Contact
line: It would take the whole crew working around the clock to remove that many panels. Then we'd have to fly through a dangerous debris field with zero protection, all in 11 hours.

title: First First Contact
line: Are you saying it can't be done?

title: First First Contact
line: No, I'm saying we have to hurry!

title: First First Contact
line: We'd take a serious beating, but, Captain, this can work.

title: First First Contact
line: Attention, all hands. Report to your commanding officers. The Archimedes needs our help, so we have to remove our hull one panel at a time. I'm calling on every officer, no matter what your usual duties are. We have to work together. It'll be close, people. Our lives will be on the line. But we are Starfleet and we never back down from a challenge. Now, get to work. Cerritos strong! Oh, and the ballroom dancing competition will have to be postponed.

title: First First Contact
line: Not now, not now!

title: First First Contact
line: Problem with the coupling?

title: First First Contact
line: No, my implant has an error message that's covering my vision.

title: First First Contact
line: That's odd. Your storage is maxed out.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, yeah, No, that makes sense. Last year, I lost all my memories of Tendi. So whenever I make a new one, I save three copies just in case it happens again.

title: First First Contact
line: Well, it's only going to get worse until you free up some space.

title: First First Contact
line: But what if I forget her again?

title: First First Contact
line: Son, if you can't keep making new memories, does it matter?

title: First First Contact
line: Man, am I going to miss those nacelles.

title: First First Contact
line: We need all volatiles deeper in the ship. Nothing explodes around here unless I'm the one blowing it up.

title: First First Contact
line: Sir, are you sure this is a good idea?

title: First First Contact
line: A powered-down viewscreen isn't going to be any help. I need to see where we're going. We're going to have to do this the old-fashioned way.

title: First First Contact
line: Try it now!

title: First First Contact
line: Still nothing.

title: First First Contact
line: Damn it. With a couple of shuttles we could redirect the ship, or at least get some crew to safety.

title: First First Contact
line: You should rest. You've been up forever.

title: First First Contact
line: I'll have a break in seven hours either way.

title: First First Contact
line: But in seven hours, we'll be dea... Oh, I see what you did there.

title: First First Contact
line: Come on.

title: First First Contact
line: Don't phaser your foot.

title: First First Contact
line: Just worry about your own thing.

title: First First Contact
line: Well, at least when I'm gone you won't have anyone pissing you off around here. I get it, you're still upset.

title: First First Contact
line: No, I'm not... and I'm pretty confident of that.

title: First First Contact
line: Look, all I meant was that you can still improve yourself by just opening up to other people.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh! You are always trying to change me. You know what? I am glad this is your last mission here, because I never want to work with you again.

title: First First Contact
line: Beckett.

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa! You okay? Dragon's blood. Access controls are fused. We're going to have to release this one manually.

title: First First Contact
line: We're out of time. Billups, tell me we're good to go.

title: First First Contact
line: We still have one more hull plate. And it's a big one.

title: First First Contact
line: Captain, if we're going, we have to go now.

title: First First Contact
line: That panel's just going to have to come off on the fly. Red alert. Helm, get us up to speed. Carefully.

title: First First Contact
line: Let's go, let's go! Everyone inside, quick!

title: First First Contact
line: Ah! Hold on. I gotta do something.

title: First First Contact
line: What if someone asks why he has it?

title: First First Contact
line: We programmed that in. He'll think it was elective.

title: First First Contact
line: Huh? Ha, ha! I can see again! But I think I remembered something I wasn't supposed to? Guys, quick! We need a hand!

title: First First Contact
line: Cetacean Ops? But don't these guys do navigation? - Wait, what are we...

title: First First Contact
line: Hey, Kimolu! Matt! Heads up!

title: First First Contact
line: Howdy, Rutherford. You're pretty sweaty. Jump those broad shoulders in here and splash around with us.

title: First First Contact
line: I would love to, but there's no time. There's a busted hull panel we need to release manually. Tendi and I can override the safety protocols, but one of you guys has to swim down and release the mag clamps.

title: First First Contact
line: The what? But the panel's outside.

title: First First Contact
line: Yeah, but the control node for the manual access clamps are down there.

title: First First Contact
line: Can't these two do it?

title: First First Contact
line: Ah, yeah, it wasn't designed for flippers.

title: First First Contact
line: Okay, all right, sorry, sorry. Er, once again, Beckett Mariner saves the day. Of course my frickin' mom'll get all the praise.

title: First First Contact
line: Oh, shut up! You're just mad because you don't want her to leave.

title: First First Contact
line: So what if I am, okay? This is the most I've gotten along with her in years, and now she decides to take off. That's messed up. And I kinda already told her I never want to work with her again.

title: First First Contact
line: Mariner is the Captain's daughter?

title: First First Contact
line: Keep up, Kimolu. Hey, Rutherford. Looking sweaty. Hop that bod in here real quick

title: First First Contact
line: I already asked him, Matt. Maybe you should keep up.

title: First First Contact
line: The captain needs our support, especially from you. Look, however this rescue goes, either we're going to be dead, or she's going to be on a new ship. Is this really how you want to leave things with her?

title: First First Contact
line: Of course not! But I can't patch things up now. I have to swim down and unclamp a thingy...

title: First First Contact
line: No, you don't! Boimler's got this.

title: First First Contact
line: You guys don't understand my family...

title: First First Contact
line: We are your family! We will always be there for you. And right now we're heading into a pile of crazy dangerous space debris!

title: First First Contact
line: Whoa. Tendi, I...

title: First First Contact
line: Ah, no, no. Just trust us. We can do this. Go to the bridge, apologize, and make sure your mom doesn't get us all killed!

title: First First Contact
line: You guys are right. You got this, Boims?

title: First First Contact
line: Yes! Go!

title: First First Contact
line: Thanks, okay! Sorry, sorry, sorry!

title: First First Contact
line: Okay, so you just gotta go all the way down and then swim the length of the hydrotube and then wedge into the filter nodule to reach the clamps. Cool?

title: First First Contact
line: Oh. Oh wow, that's a really long tunnel. Er, I'm not sure...

title: First First Contact
line: Boimler, you're the one who wants to dive into the unknown. Now's your chance. So, get diving!

title: First First Contact
line: So, you guys doing anything for Captain Freeman Day?

line: Rutherford, stop being impressed with the thing that's stealing our jobs.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sorry, sorry. No. I don't know what I would do without the Cerritos, but... Ooo, baby, look at this code.

title: The Stars at Night
line: At least someone found a silver lining.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh man, I wonder how the bridge crew's taking it.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Doctor T'Ana's probably like, "Holy fucking shit. I'm a doctor, not an asshole."

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ooo, ooo, do Ransom.

title: The Stars at Night
line: "If I can't have my private gym, I might move back to Barcelona."

title: The Stars at Night
line: Barcelona.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Okay, okay. Wait, wait, wait, who's this? "Hey, baby bear. The only thing I'll miss is being able to eject the warp core".

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shush!

title: The Stars at Night
line: "I talk about prophets even more than a Ferengi."

title: The Stars at Night
line: Is that what I sound like to you?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Lieutenant Shaxs. No. I... I didn't mean...

title: The Stars at Night
line: I was going to ask you for help with my phaser, but I guess I'm just a big joke to you!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Wait. I'm sorry! Ah. I can't leave the Cerritos knowing a senior officer hates me.

title: The Stars at Night
line: The longer Mariner's not around, the more Boimler kind of loses his grasp on reality.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I still feel awful about how we acted when she got transferred.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, we should've been more supportive.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I hope she's okay, all alone out in space. She's probably miserable.

title: The Stars at Night
line: All right!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Damn you, Starfleet!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ha! Well, nice try, but I'm not Starfleet.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You're still a filthy hew-mon.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You got me there. Hey, I got the idol.

title: The Stars at Night
line: And you're sneaking out without making a big deal of it, right?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, totally. I'm playing it very cool. Better luck next time, you dumb grave robbers. Okay, Petra, time to go. Beaming would be good anytime now, please.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Having a little fun down there, were we?

title: The Stars at Night
line: You gonna send me to the brig?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I don't care what you do, as long as we can get this bad boy to the Qualor Historical Museum. Ooo, and our route takes us right through the Bitrus Expanse. Want to excavate a couple temples on the way?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, I do. The more hidden the better. Rescuing artifacts from black market thieves is great, but, you know, the best part of this gig is that you never get pissed off. Thanks for letting me do my thing.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, well, with our funding, we'll both be able to do our thing for as long as we want.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh yeah, who's footing the bill for all this? It has to cost, like, a fortune.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aw, that's cute, pretending you have any concept of how money works.

title: The Stars at Night
line: But we donate everything to museums, so how do we pay for our fuel and gear? How'd you get this ship?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'll handle the finances, and you worry about grabbing us some frosty Rom-Ales for the warp.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Hmm.

title: The Stars at Night
line: It's understandable that the captain isn't keen on losing her command, which is why I would like to offer her a promotion. Fleet captain of the entire Texas-class.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I don't want some operations desk job.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ah, wait till you see the uniform. It has four epaulets.

title: The Stars at Night
line: This is his vanity project, not mine.

title: The Stars at Night
line: His ships do seem superior to the Cali-class.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Well, then he should prove it. I challenge you to a mission race. If your drones really are better than my crew, then it should be easy.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain Freeman is begging to prove her obsolescence. You can't allow her to humiliate her crew.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sorry, I didn't know Buenamigo was in charge here.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh please. These fine admirals know that I am right, but, if this is what you want...

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're doing what?!

title: The Stars at Night
line: A second contact race.

title: The Stars at Night
line: What even is that?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I made it up on the spot. A multi-planet mission, timed and judged.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Repairs, outpost install, resupply. We could do these in our sleep.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Exactly, and it'll be the first time for the Aledo. That gives us an edge. Make sure your departments know we're not just fighting for ourselves. We have to do this for the entire California-class.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Let's see some hustle, people. We're doing Galaxy-class engineering today. Do you hear me, Mister Rutherford?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ah! Sorry, sir. Yes, sir.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I want to see Commander Data-level work, people. Those isolinear chips better be a blur.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Let's go, let's go! I didn't spend seven fucking years on a goddamn Oberth to get knocked down to station physician.

title: The Stars at Night
line: All this work to become a senior science officer. Now there might not be any officers.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Tendi, that's cantaloupe talk. I want to you to be a can-aloupe. Remember your training, and you'll do great.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Thanks, Doctor Migleemo. At first, I was worried...

title: The Stars at Night
line: What are you doing here?! Get the fuck out of my sickbay!

title: The Stars at Night
line: You need to sit? Cross your leg over the back of it and slam down. Command that chair.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sir, please, I respect you and all Bajorans.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, so all Bajorans are the same?

title: The Stars at Night
line: What? No, no, I didn't mean...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Get away from me! I need to concentrate on the mission.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're in position, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I should thank you for doing this, Captain. It's the perfect way for me to show off the Aledo's capabilities.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Not a problem at all, Admiral. Can't wait to see you fall on that smug face.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aledo, I'm uploading mission parameters now.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Orders received.

title: The Stars at Night
line: On my mark, you may proceed.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mark.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Warp me!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shall I commence, Admiral?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Negative, Aledo. Let's make this interesting. Give them a head start.

title: The Stars at Night
line: On behalf of all Galardonians, I want to thank...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, no problem. Alpha, Beta, install the rigging. Gamma, Epsilon, replace the old system with the updated distribution nodes. Go, go, go!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Rutherford, toss me the scanner that looks like a phase discriminator.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I know I've seen this code before.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Rutherford!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ah! Sorry. Here you go.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Done.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Whoa!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain, half a power plant just beamed in beside us.

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Aledo can transport prefabricated modules? We have to move!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Billups to Cerritos, six to beam up.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We've arrived at LT-358, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Scans indicate the probe was right. No signs of life.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're in the lead! Let's keep it that way, people. Begin outpost installation.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Huh.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Let's go, people. We got to wrap this up.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sir, I'm sorry, but we have to stop construction.

title: The Stars at Night
line: What are you talking about?

title: The Stars at Night
line: The scans missed microscopic signs of life in the soil. We need to make sure it isn't sentient.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Everyone, stop! Captain, we have a potential microbial life down here. We need to do a full self-awareness assessment before we finish the outpost.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Wha...? Of course. But hurry, we've just lost our lead.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're good.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Okay, go, go, go! Move, people! Let's go!

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'm sorry. I... I could've sworn there was life.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No, no, no, this stuff has a multiphasic charge. Confuses the shit out of a tricorder. Let's go.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Outpost is complete, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I need warp now! We just have to deliver supplies to Ockmenic 9. It's one of those Brigadoon-type planets that only phases into our dimension for a couple hours a year. Hopefully, we can catch up to the Aledo before it appears.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ugh, this blows! It's taking forever.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Just don't embarrass me, okay? You're the one who begged to come with me, all right?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Well, I wanted to see the ship.

title: The Stars at Night
line: They're gonna be in orbit. It's gonna be like a tiny little dot. You're not going to see them at all.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Whoa, ho, ho, ho, ho. Hey! Down here!

title: The Stars at Night
line: They can't hear you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Thanks for all the stuff!

title: The Stars at Night
line: All right, shut up for a second. Supplies received. The Ockmenians appreciate all Starfleet's...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Next time, send a replicator!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, my God, why are you like this?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain, the planet is already phasing away.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No. No! Oh, we're too late.

title: The Stars at Night
line: God, we would've won if I hadn't defended the life of some inert dust.

title: The Stars at Night
line: When secondary scans find life, you have to drop everything. That's, like, the entire point of the prime directive. Right, Rutherford? Back me up here.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, yeah, sure. You did the right thing.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Thanks, but if it was the right thing, why didn't the Aledo slow down too?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Huh? Ha, ha! You're right!

title: The Stars at Night
line: That was weird, but, I'll take it.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Carol, I trust you're ready to admit defeat?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I was about to say the same to you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Aledo trounced you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sure, because it skipped analyzing signs of life on LT-358.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Come on, that's a barren rock.

title: The Stars at Night
line: But there was a chance it wasn't. I don't always love the constraints of the prime directive, but your little toy totally ignored it.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, stop. This is a rounding error.

title: The Stars at Night
line: One that proves the Texas-class isn't fit for duty. I'm sorry, Les, but I have to take this to the council.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Nuh-uh. Nuh-uh!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Wait, wait. What are you nuh-uh'ing?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I figured it out! This code is mine. The Aledo runs on my AI. There's minor changes, but it's all there.

title: The Stars at Night
line: But how does that make any sense? It was Admiral Buenamigo's secret project.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, but I coded this back when I was the old me, the angry ship racing me. Gah!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Keep it together.

title: The Stars at Night
line: How much do you want to erase?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Everything that has to do with me or the program.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Admiral Buenamigo. He's the one that had me working on the prototype for the Texas-class ships.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh! He's the one who erased your memories!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, he used my designs, my code... Oh, that's the same code I used for Badgey.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh no. A starship can't have daddy issues.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We got to warn the Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No. This would set the Texas-class project back decades.

title: The Stars at Night
line: If that's what it takes to ensure that...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain, you need to see this!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ensign, I'm busy.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Rutherford?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, that's right, and I figured it out. The Aledo's code is corrupted. He erased my memory to cover it up. The AI is the same one that killed Shaxs.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Why did I stop at your memory? I should've erased all of you!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Les, what the hell is this?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Starfleet is so competitive.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Once you're an admiral, you hit a wall. I've been trying for years to make a name for myself. I'm not letting you take it from me, not after everything I did to get us here.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Everything you did? Wait. That means...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yes, yes, I set you up. I was sure you would fail at negotiations on Deep Space 9, but you stumbled through that fiasco.

title: The Stars at Night
line: And the Breen?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Of course I knew they were on Brekka. I needed the Aledo to save the day, and you handed me a perfect disaster.

title: The Stars at Night
line: My crew could've been killed!

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Texas-class will keep countless others out of danger. The good of the many, Carol.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Sir, you don't understand. The code you're using, its emotional processing isn't stable. You can't bring those ships online.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You are not one of those bad faith admirals that's up to no good.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You're better than this, Les.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'm really not. You know, I'll... I'll say you attacked the Aledo out of anger when you lost the race. It defended itself.

title: The Stars at Night
line: What?!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aledo, activate independent control, command authorisation Buenamigo Alpha 3-1 .

title: The Stars at Night
line: I am now fully autonomous.

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Cerritos is under enemy command. Block all communications, and destroy it. Aledo, do you understand? I said attack the Cerritos!

title: The Stars at Night
line: I don't take orders from you anymore, Father.

title: The Stars at Night
line: What? Aledo, deactivate independence.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I will burn your heart in a fire.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aledo, stand down. Stand down, I comm...

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Aledo's attacking the station!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Activating Dallas and Corpus Christi.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shields up! Red Alert!

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Aledo has activated two more Texas-class ships, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: There's too many of them. Put out a distress call, all channels.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Okay. Qualor III. These guys love a party. They're gonna want to celebrate when we hand this over.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'm still wiped from all that Ferengi mocking. I'm gonna sit this one out. Ooo, bring me back a slushy.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Hey, I'll bring you back two.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Okay. Time to find out who's funding this little operation.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Forgot my punch card. You got a second wind to dig into my private files, huh?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah, see, I'm not into the whole mysterious benefactors thing. This whole operation is shady as hell.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Fine. Go on, then, dig away.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Admiral Picard? No way.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yes way. The Guild has a huge endowment from Jean-Luc. That guy loves mummies even more than you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aw, I was hoping for a Romulan or at least a Xindi cabal.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Hold on. You wanted to find something nefarious?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I think, deep down, I was looking for a reason to go back to Starfleet.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Are you joking? You just escaped all that.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I know, but I... I think I want to be a part of something that stands for the greater good.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, and archeology doesn't? That's a bit fucking rude.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No. I mean, it's fun, but how many old brown pots do we really need?

title: The Stars at Night
line: All right, well, that's just even ruder. I'd rather be digging up pots than serving on your old ship today.

title: The Stars at Night
line: What does that mean?

title: The Stars at Night
line: It's on all the news feeds. As usual, Starfleet's getting people blown up left, right and center.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, my God. We have to help.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No, we don't. It's a bloodbath.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Those are my friends.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I said stop. It's not our fight.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I know, Starfleet's just an idea, but the people matter. You served on the Victory. You know that.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mariner, it's suicide. We're just one ship.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I know, but we have to do something.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ugh. Fine. You're gonna get me killed, aren't you?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Only one way to find out.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain, what are your orders?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Prepare sickbay for casualties and hail the station. Get me communication with the...

title: The Stars at Night
line: We got the Van Citters warping in!

title: The Stars at Night
line: They're tearing her up!

title: The Stars at Night
line: We need to buy Starfleet some time. Open a channel. Aledo, I have the man who wrote your code. He's got the ability to delete you unless you stand down.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I do? Oh, yeah. You better stop attacking, or you're dunsel.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I will burn your heart in a fire.

title: The Stars at Night
line: They're... they're coming pretty fast, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Good, then they're not killing any more civilians. Maximum warp me.

title: The Stars at Night
line: They're still in pursuit, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're holding at warp eight, but they're gaining.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Billups, I need full throttle.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'll give you everything I can, but I don't know how much the struts can take.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Let's find out.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Brace yourselves. This is about to get rough.

title: The Stars at Night
line: That bought us some time, but they're closing the gap.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We're gonna have to make our own luck. Give me options.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I say we eject the warp core.

title: The Stars at Night
line: We could drop out of warp and surprise attack.

title: The Stars at Night
line: AI doesn't get surprised.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Can we rendezvous with the Titan?

title: The Stars at Night
line: No, they're across the system.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Wait, guys, Shaxs said...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Let's modify the deflector dish and use it as a giant weapon.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Is there something I can say to trap those AI in a logic spiral?

title: The Stars at Night
line: No, I safeguarded against paradoxes.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ugh. People, we're missing something!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shut up and listen to Shaxs!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mister Boimler!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Please, Lieutenant, what did you say?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I... kind of said we should eject the warp core.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, that's what he always suggests. Ah. And it's brilliant.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Er, it is?

title: The Stars at Night
line: We can use the warp core as a mine...

title: The Stars at Night
line: And drop it right in their path.

title: The Stars at Night
line: But wouldn't that rip us out of warp?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Better than getting ripped apart by photon torpedoes.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mister Shaxs, make it so.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Really, Captain? Oh, by the prophets.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yeah! Oh, yeah.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Whoo! You've got this, sir!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Thank you so much.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You are all too kind.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Arnock, on the night of his joining.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shaxs! Shaxs! Shaxs!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, thank you. Thank you so much. I've dreamed of doing this for so long. Eject.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Did it work?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Yes! The explosion took out the... Wait. The Aledo survived the blast!

title: The Stars at Night
line: We need to abandon ship now.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Belay that order.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mariner, no! Get out of here. You can't help us on your own.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Er, yeah, I know. I brought help.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain, another ship is dropping out of warp. It's the... Oakland?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Just hang on a little longer, Cerritos. We've got your back.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Captain Ramsey? No, get out of here! The Aledo is too powerful. A Cali-class ship won't stand a chance.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I know, right? That's why I called all of them.

title: The Stars at Night
line: All of what?

title: The Stars at Night
line: It's the Alhambra. The San Diego. The San Clemente. The Sherman Oaks, the Vacaville, the Burbank, the Fresno, Santa Monica, San Jose, Sacramento, Culver City, Anaheim, Riverside, Vallejo, West Covina, Pacific Palisades, Redding, Eureka, Mount Shasta! It's all of them, Captain.

title: The Stars at Night
line: The Merced is at your disposal, Captain Freeman.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Carlsbad's always happy to lend a hand.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Shields up, red alert. The Inglewood's ready to kick some ass.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I think what he said was, attack pattern Delta, full spread!

title: The Stars at Night
line: I will burn your heart in a fire.

title: The Stars at Night
line: She's back! Mariner!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Awesome!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mariner, the reporter. I'm so sorry I told you to apologize for something you didn't do.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aw, it's okay, you big dummy. I know you were just trying to protect me.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Is this one of those you say it's fine, but you're actually still mad, and it's gonna blow up in my face situations? Because I will happily continue to apologize.

title: The Stars at Night
line: No, I'm not mad. I got a taste of civilian life, and I am just so happy to be back.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Look, we all should've done more to defend you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Nobody handled that worse than me. I love you guys. After all that, you're keeping the implant?

title: The Stars at Night
line: It robbed me of my memories, and it was used to cover up deadly crimes, but it's so cool! I'm still finding submenus I had no idea were in there.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'm proud of you, Ensign. You were under immense pressure today, but you still stood up for science.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aw, thanks, Doctor Migleemo.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Command was so impressed with your progress, they've transferred another promising young officer to join in your training.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Oh, my gosh! Hi. I'm Tendi. Welcome to the Cerritos. We're gonna be training together.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Greetings. I am T'Lyn. Is there someplace quiet where we can discuss my orientation?

title: The Stars at Night
line: First, you got to meet everyone. Guys, this is my new study buddy!

title: The Stars at Night
line: You.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Lieutenant, look, I know you don't want me talking to you, but I really am sorry...

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ha, ha! You gave me everything I ever asked for. You're in the bear pack now.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Are you my bridge buddy?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Absolutely, baby bear.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Aw, bears.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Hey, Mom.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Er... Beckett, I want to formerly reinstate you to the Cerritos crew, if you're...

title: The Stars at Night
line: It's good to see you, too.

title: The Stars at Night
line: I'm sorry. I don't know why I didn't trust you.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Mmm, maybe because I spent years making sure you didn't. I think I needed this. I'm ready to get back on the right path.

title: The Stars at Night
line: So, you want to be a captain someday?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Ooo, I don't know about that. I for sure want to be in Starfleet. One step at a time?

title: The Stars at Night
line: I think that's a great idea.

title: The Stars at Night
line: You know, I was actually thinking it would be good to have a mentor, so, can Ransom train me?

title: The Stars at Night
line: Of course. Jack, Mariner's back on board, and she's gonna be your shadow!

title: The Stars at Night
line: Wh... What? No.

title: The Stars at Night
line: Thanks, Mom! I'm gonna be at your side at all times. Commanding.

title: The Stars at Night
