line: Silence. I've been stabbing commanders in the back since before your mother killed her first traitor. Wipe this crumb from our path so I can focus on being suspicious.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Commander, our systems... they're not responding!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That's impossible. Fire disruptors!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, it's true. Our shields are deactivating.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Go to cloak!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Let me die!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, no, no. Stay with me, Shaxs. You're gonna get through this. We're exploring the galactic frontier, we need to stay flexible. Wow, you're really tight today. What's got you so tense, amigo?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: One minute T'Ana's all over me, the next she says I'm too clingy and she won't come out from under the bed.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Have you tried scratching your fingers on the covers and going pss-pss-pss-pss?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Of course I have!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: How's it going with the new lieutenants?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Good, except for Mariner.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Mmm-hmm.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I've got her right where I want her. She thinks she knows the score, but trust me, she won't be my problem for long. Hot fudge sundaes after this?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, yeah.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ha, ha. Cheat day.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: We put a lot of lightyears on these orange slabs. I promised myself I wouldn't get emotional.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aw, how could you not? We spent so much time hanging out, staying up late ranking captains by cuteness, swapping bodies because of those cosmic rays.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: We learned too much about each other that day.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'm even gonna miss the dent I made from all the times I slammed my head on the ceiling during a red alert. Goodbye, Denty.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You okay, Mariner? Need any help packing?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No thanks. Ransom's just gonna knock me back down to ensign anyway.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: He promoted you last week.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I just heard him bragging to Shaxs that he's messing with me.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What? Why?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I mean, who knows. His brain is, like, the only part of his body he doesn't work out.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: But didn't he say he was going to support you?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, they always do, and then the second I speak my mind, bam. Right back to being an ensign. They always think it's, like, a learning experience.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, is he dumb or playing mind games?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Well, who cares. I'm not falling for it. Ransom's just waiting for me to mess up, huh? Fine. I'm gonna become an insubordination supernova and control my own fate.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: But you're not actually gonna blow anything up, right?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No. I'm gonna talk back, break the rules, crack some inappropriate jokes in front of an ambassador. When I get demoted, it'll be because I earned it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Well, that should prove to be a disaster. Should we go check out our rooms?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah, come on, Rutherford. Oh, right. I'm sorry.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You guys go ahead. I'm still a lowly ensign.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Urgh, I totally forgot you didn't get promoted with us. You exude lieutenant junior grade energy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I don't know if I'm going to like not bunking five feet away from you. I mean, how will I sleep without someone muttering about the warp threshold?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aw, Tendi, don't worry, I'll just get a promotion today so I can join you guys.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I... don't know if it's that easy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I just have to do some amazing engineering. How hard could it be?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oof. What I would give for his confidence.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Huh. Maybe you'd have it if you didn't hIt your head so much.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Don't say stuff like that in front of Denty.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What up, nerds? Who's ready to get mission-y?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Almost on time, Mariner. Well done. This is Ensign Gary's first away mission, so I'd like you to take him under your wing. You know, once you change into your uniform.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Nah. You know, I thought I'd keep it "caszh" today. Simple mission, simple outfit. This guy gets it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Okay. Speaking of the mission, please fill Ensign Gary in on the particulars.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Can do, hoss. Boom. Today we're dealing with a classic menage.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Menage?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: A menagerie.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Well, it's basically just a big-ass alien zoo full of aliens run by another alien. This one scooped up a couple of humans... by accident, so we got to bust them the fuck out.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, I... I didn't know it would be dangerous.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: It's not. And this place has a strict no weapons policy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ha. Menageries are always capturing humans then turning them back over to Starfleet. We'll be in and out, no biggie. Right, Jack?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Let's just get in the shuttle.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, when you're a lieutenant JG you can call him Jack?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I always call him Jack because, you know, socially, we're equals. Right, Jack?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: We're leaving now.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh boy, Mirror Universe Archer, you're gonna love our new room.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aah! The nacelle is right there? Okay, not the best view, but I'm sure I'll get used to it. Ah! Lil' Archer!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Take her in nice and easy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aye aye, sir. Nice and easy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What are you doing?!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Slow down, slow down, slow down!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I don't want to die!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Was that nice and easy enough?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That... was some great piloting. Let's get to work.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I need to replicate some new pants.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh-ho, greetings. Narj is happy to welcome you to Narj's Miraculous Menagerarium, recently voted one of the top thousand menageries in the quadrant. Narj will be sad to lose the humans. They're incredibly popular.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: How did they even get locked up here in the first place?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Accidentally scooped up with a shipment of bipedals. Narj has to admit that Narj does have a hard time telling non-botanical creatures apart.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Happens all the time. Humans are always getting stuck in menageries. But don't worry, I brought my best team with me. We'll be out of your leaves lickity split.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: His best team? What the hell is that supposed to mean?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I guess the commander likes us.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What? No, he doesn't. He's messing with me. He's setting me up for humiliation when he comes down on me later.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Are you guys breaking up or something?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah, we are, as coworkers. And we're gonna force it right now.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'm having a little trouble decoding the dynamic here, but I'd really like to be left out of it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hey, Narj. What got you in the prison business, huh? Just a cruel weirdo who loves locking people up?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: A prison is a place for criminals. I've given these sweet creatures a safe home.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What about this little guy? He doesn't deserve to be in your fucked-up hobby.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hobby? The Moopsy is Narj's favorite.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Do you imprison everything you like?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Of course.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Mariner, it's not our place to judge the menagerie. We're just here to collect the humans.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, you're here to collect humans. I'm here to be human, which means calling bullshit when I see it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Narj does not understand. Narj abides by Federation law.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Don't worry about it. She's a firebrand, but I trust her with my life.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, you're not getting in my head.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: And I can't wait until we're the same rank again, because then we can get back to praising people behind their backs. I think Boimler's gonna be a great lieutenant.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I don't want you to pressure yourself to get a promotion just so we can hang out. It can take years.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Don't worry, I've been working on something pretty impressive. Billups is gonna love it. Commander Billups. Can I run something by you, sir?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Of course, Mister Rutherford. What's up?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: For the past year, I've been working to decrease vibration in the warp manifold by a factor of .05.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: .05 ? That can't be right.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Well, it wasn't easy, but with a little ingenuity...

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, I mean it can't be right because a few minutes ago Ensign Livik decreased the vibration by a factor of .06.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ensign Livik? Who's that?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: The new guy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Livik! Livik! Livik! Livik!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Livik.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ha! Stupid bussard light. You ain't so tough now.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'll tell you, if Livik keeps this up, he'll have a promotion in no time. Let's fire up his protocol right now. I want to see that .06 in action.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Help.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: And right this way. Hello, humans. arj hopes you have enjoyed your stay in the Menage. Now, it is time for you to return to your natural habitat.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I know you're taking a hit losing these guys. We appreciate the positive attitude.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Not to worry. My real moneymakers are the Pyrithian Swamp Gobblers over there.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hmm? Oh, fuck! The Moopsy is free!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, no, your cuddliest prisoner is loose. Whatever shall we do?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You don't understand. Everything here is incredibly dangerous.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Can't be worse than the Swamp Gobblers.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Of course it's worse! They only gobble you. The Moopsy drinks your bones!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: How does something drink bones?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Holy fuck!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Run! Run for your lives!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Come on, come on, come on, show me that sweet incremental improvement. Yes! Commander Billups? You might want to sit down. I increased the power output of the Tucker Tubes by seven pico-cochrans.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That's great, Rutherford. I just hope those adjustments can apply to the Billups Tubes.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: The what now?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ensign Livik figured out how to add a third tube without triggering a Heisenberg collapse.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: A third tube?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah, and he named it the Billups Tubes. Classic Livik. I... I don't even know what we use these for, but I love them.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Livik! Livik!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Livik.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wow, so close to the holodecks. This is gonna be awesome.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That's more like it. Thanks for helping me get my new quarters, sir.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Happy to help, baby bear. Well, have fun getting settled in. I've got to run, Doctor T'Ana and I have a date on the holodeck.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Have fun.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You ready to get disgusting?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Has that ever stopped you before?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Computer, activate T'Ana program 35.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Er, how thin are these walls?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: With me, my merry men. We must make haste to the castle to save the Maid Marion. Ow! What are you doing?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Shut your fucking face. I'm Robin Hood now. Toodley doo! Shaxs, hold him down.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You've already hurt him pretty bad.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Kick his head!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Help! A cat has stolen my hat and arrows.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Can't we just do the program as intended for once?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: And now that I am president of all Starfleet, allow me to present my inaugural scatting.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Why is there a room between two holodecks?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Don't make me arrow you!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ow! Stop that.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Make me!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ow!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: So much... for these new pants.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Er, no weapons policy in a death-trap zoo? Fucking genius. What's your problem?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Do I really have to say it?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, you think I let that thing out?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You've been pulling insubordinate crap all day.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, that is rich.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You're the one who let a bone-eating monster out of its cage.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Er, Narj will make sure the Moopsy is still attacking the door.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah, I've been pushing your buttons, because I knew you were looking for a reason to demote me, and of course it's for something I didn't even do.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, why would I want to demote you?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Gee, I don't know. How about our entire working relationship?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What? I'm a good boss.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You stabbed me in the foot with a battle blade. You... you turned into a giant head and tried to eat me. You tried to trick me into messing up on that space elevator...

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That was an orbital lift.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: And then, after you promised you would believe in me, I heard you tell Shaxs in the gym that I wasn't gonna be your problem anymore.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What? The gym? You heard that?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ha! You admit it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: All I meant is that you're not gonna be my problem because I'm not gonna take the bait with your insubordination.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Bait? What... what are you talking about?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ah, it's all in your file. You've been promoted a dozen times, then you always get demoted for acting out.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah, 'cause I'm a, you know, I'm a free spirit.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No. Because you're manipulating your commanding officers. I'm gonna be the first one who doesn't fall for it. Trust me, it's not easy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I do not try to get demoted.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What have you been doing all day?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, I... I was... You... Okay, fine, that was just today.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You always do.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No, I don't. I... Shut up. Why would I do that?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I don't know. But I'm sorry to say, you still have my unwavering support, no matter how hard you make it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I didn't let the Moopsy out.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I believe you.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Okay. Thank you.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'm glad you two worked your whole thing out, but can we maybe focus on the bone-drinking monster this plant guy probably set loose?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You accuse Narj of Moopsy freeing? Narj would never do such a thing.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Not even if we got killed and you kept your valuable humans? Plus, you're a tree. You probably don't even have bones.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ridiculous! Narj is ossified. Narj... Hmm?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: It's chugging him!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, the door. Phew, no ladders. Now it can't get back through those vents.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah. Now it's trapped in the... station's main control room.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ah, this is perfect. A nice, dark Jefferies Tube where we can't hear anyone decapitate Peter Pan. Ah, this is much better than the bunks.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hey, Boimler.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aah!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What you doing in here?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hey, Rutherford. Uh, I live here now. You doing a systems check?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Nah, I'm trying to find a way to diffuse heat conduction by a few nano joules.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, some ensign just came through here doing the exact same thing. Seemed like a real wunderkind. I was impressed.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Livik. Leave some minor improvements for the rest of us, guy!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Dinner later?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Sure.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hey, calm down.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You calm down! If you two hadn't been bickering, we wouldn't be falling into a planet!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Nobody's dying today, because I'm gonna crawl through the vents, unlock the door, and get the Moopsy to chase me out, so you two can rush in and stabilize the orbit while it drinks my bones.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Stand down, Mariner.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Jack, we are plummeting. Even if this works, we'll only stop re-entry by the skin of our teeth.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, that's it. Mariner, punch me in the face. That's an order, Lieutenant.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Okay.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Come on, as hard as you can.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: That thing wants bones? We'll give it bones.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, you're a genius.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I should have been an outpost scientist.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, Rutherford, you've been working yourself to death all day. You don't have to do this.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: No. This time I nailed it. I sped up the replicators by nine whole femtoseconds. I'm definitely getting a promotion now. You and I'll be the same rank and stay friends forever.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Billups. Whew. It took an unbelievable amount of engineering, but I finally managed...

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'm sure whatever you did is great, Mister Rutherford, but it'll have to wait until after the pip ceremony.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Huh? Livik!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I'm sorry, Tendi. I let you down.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Mister Rutherford, stand at attention.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: What?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I am your superior, Ensign. Do it. We'll be friends no matter what our ranks are. We're going to spend tons of time hanging out and talking about science and telling jokes and, you know, do all the things we used to do. And that's an order.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, my gosh, I just gave my first order. Oh.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Man, now I wish I hadn't turned down all those promotions.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Sorry, what?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: You know, for saving the Cerritos from the Pakleds, and the Rubidoux from the space jellyfish, stuff like that.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait. Why did you turn them all down?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Because I didn't want my own room where I wouldn't be near you.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aw, Rutherford, but, can't you just go accept one right now?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Nah, they take it really seriously in engineering. You have to earn it with a scientific...

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hey, Billups! Can Rutherford have his promotion for that time he removed the hull?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Oh, sure. Ah, sorry, Livik, maybe next time.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wait, I can just ask for stuff I deserve?

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I guess.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Rutherford! Rutherford!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Hooray! Thanks, everyone.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Rutherford. And also Tendi.

line: Moopsy.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Got you, you cuddly little murderer.

line: We say-bih-eye da say-sa orbih!

line: What's that, Gummy?

line: We stabilized the station's orbit. Oh, man, victory really is that much sweeter when you almost got killed.

line: I just wish we could have figured out how this little guy got out in the first place. I mean, it clearly wasn't Narj, dude was brimming with bones.

line: Let's get these humans out of here. Starfleet security can figure it out.

line: Well, at least it wasn't our fault. You know, humans are always being blamed for being dangerous, but, we don't have claws or fangs, or...

line: Did you fuckers rewire the Moopsy door? You could've got us all killed.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Wow. I guess humans really are the most dangerous game.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Damn it.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Lieutenant junior grade's log... Nope, no, too weird. Let's go with Mariner's log. So, yeah, of course it was the humans in the menagerie that set the Moopsy free. They'd seen how profitable they were as an attraction, so they wanted to kill Narj and keep the station for themselve. Humans. We really are the worst. So, anyway, instead of bringing them to the Cerritos, we left them in the menagerie until somebody else has time to pick them up. Could take a while. As for Ransom, it took some doing, but Doctor T'Ana was able to fix him up with a new set of chompers.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Just don't eat any hard stuff for a few days while the veneers set. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go kill the Sheriff of Nottingham for being a little fuckface. Ah ha!

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: So, uh, sorry I knocked all your teeth out. I ended up only needing, like, ten of them.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I was just happy you were following my orders.

line: I'm sorry I doubted you, sir.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: I haven't always been the most supportive over the years, but at least now you know I'm definitely not gonna let you self-sabotage anymore. So, maybe we can cool it on the reign of terror.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Yeah. Yeah. That'll be, er, interesting.

line: Trust me, Mariner, you're gonna be a great officer. Just like me.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Congrats on the promotion, man.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Thanks. And great call on us being roommates. We're gonna get even better quarters than if we were alone.

line: Oh, really? No way.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Aah! No! Oh, no, no, no, no, no, this can't be happening.

line: Whoa! That's bright. Just got to dim the vie ports, and we're all set. Hope you don't mind me tinkering on projects all night. Ow! If you see any sparks, just stamp them out.

title: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
line: Ooh! Ah... Huh. You know what? This is already starting to feel like home.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Captain's log, Stardate 58759.1. The Cerritos is visiting the Federation world Corazonia, an artificial megastructure in a bespoke star system designed by a long-extinct alien species. The ring has been home to the Corazonians, who enjoy perfect climate and surface conditions thanks to Vexilon, the environmental computer installed by the ring's original designers. Fortunately, Vexilon is a benevolent ally with no interest in world domination. The Corazonians share a deep bond with their caretaker.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Thank you, for making the trip on short notice, Captain. We're very concerned about Vexilon.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well, he's not trying to subjugate anyone, is he? I thought he was a friendly computer.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: He is, but his hardware is ancient, wearing down. Vexilon has been operating with less accuracy than we are accustomed.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Your world computer's lagging?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The weather has become unpredictable. One minute it's blue skies, the next it's blizzards.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: His geographic processes are faltering, too. Just yesterday, one of our rivers reversed its flow and flooded a mountain.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We're all artists and poets, but I've been so stressed. Just look at the terrible statues I made last week.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeesh. Yeah, that's a pretty clumsy expression of form.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Those are our finest works. We're talking about those over there.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well, why don't we just go check on Vexilon, and afterward you can tell us all about your creative process.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Just an amateur lack of focus and balance.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ransom!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Welcome to Corazonia, Captain. We appreciate Starfleet's help. Please enjoy some iced tea.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah! That's hot!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Damn it! I'm so stupid!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It's totally normal for a planetary operating system to need some maintenance every once in a while.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No one's judging you.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah. Thank you. It's just embarrassing. I've been fine for a millennia, but now I can't even control my monsoon seasons.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Why don't I just pop your control panel and take a look at your circuits? I'm sure we can have you up and running in no time.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Captain, we have engineers who could...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Stand down, Jack. I minored in archaic technology back at the Academy. I think I've got this.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Thank you, Captain. I don't deserve this treatment. I hope this isn't taking you away from more important work.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, shh. Not at all. We needed to stop in and retrofit the power relay Starfleet installed during first contact anyway. I've got one of my lieutenants on that now.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, this is it. Your first away mission as a commander. No big deal. You've got this. You are boss, Boimler, and you're gonna nail...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Lieutenant Boimler.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What?! I mean, hi. I mean, er... yes, T'Lyn?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Your team is waiting. Have you completed your confidence-boosting ritual?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, that's not what I was doing. I was just, er, running a last-minute check of supplies. Has everyone tested their comms? Boimler to T'Lyn. Yah!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: All equipment is in adequate condition to accomplish our errand.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It's not an errand, it's a mission. My first mission as commander. It's pretty cool, right?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Perhaps we should proceed.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ensigns, at attention. This is a cut-and-dry power terminal upgrade. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to come to me or Provisional Lieutenant Junior Grade T'Lyn, who's on site in case any science stuff happens.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Everything that has ever occurred is science stuff.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, er, right. That went pretty well, I'd say.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I do not know to what you are referring. We have not started the repair.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I mean, talking to my team. I've had good bosses and bad ones. I just don't want to repeat their mistakes.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Your caution is warranted. Statistically, ensigns serving under recently promoted commanders are more likely to experience death and/or dismemberment.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Death?!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes. And/or dismemberment.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well, luckily this mission's pretty tame. It's just swapping out some terminals.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The component pieces are unstable and could detonate at any moment.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Wha...?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The retrofit must be conducted in precise order, or the terminal will explode.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It's like disarming a building-sized bomb?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The similarity is not inaccurate.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: All right, gang. Who's ready to be careful?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I wonder how Boimler's doing down there on his mission.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, he's either doing great or super overthinking it and getting sweaty.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I don't know why. Being a lieutenant junior grade doesn't seem too different from being an ensign to me.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, okay. It's the same, huh? Well, what if I told you we now have access to this?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The anomaly storage room?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yep! Anything that requires further study or might need to be returned to its previous entity is kept right here.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That's the hat that turned Billups into a church tower. I wouldn't even authorize myself for this. A lot of it is dangerous.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah! Don't touch that! Do you want your head to fall off and skitter away?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Greetings and salutations!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yuck. A Betazoid gift box. These things creep me out.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That'll be dee dah widdle widdle dee dah.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Why?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: This is a message for Rutherford. I don't want to be in this room. I want to live in your quarters.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, er, no, thank you. Is this guy sentient?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No, they... they just tend to pick up phrases they overhear.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Eat a bag of Borg, shitty motherfucker.

line: I didn't know that Doctor T'Ana came in here.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, no way. It's the Wadi Chula game. The one that traps you inside until you solve its annoying challenges.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, hell yeah. The one with, like, the pastel triangles and the little girl doing hopscotch, and everybody's like... ♪ Allamalay lemon meringue. ♪

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Lieutenants Tendi, Mariner and Rutherford, report to the isolinear chip junction immediately.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: On the way. Urgh. I thought we had the afternoon to ourselves.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I told you it didn't feel too different from being an ensign.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: At least this'll be something interesting. No more mindless, repetitive tasks for us.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Took you long enough. I need you three to scan each and every one of these isolinear chips by hand.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What?! But there are thousands of them.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, and there's a .015% deviation in the fault sensor, which is why it needs to be done by hand.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Can't it just wait until we repair the sensor?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Wow. Why didn't I think of that? Oh, right, I did. But the sensor detected a single malfunctioning chip before it went down. You three need to find it.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: This isn't so bad. Ooo, maybe we can sing a song...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Once an hour, the room fills with nitrogen coolant, so keep your breathers handy. The chips can get scalding hot, so watch out for that. Oh, and Billups' ferret got out this morning, so report to him if it bites you.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Lancelot's in here? Ah!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Okay, you were right. This is feeling pretty ensign-y.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Huh. It doesn't make any sense. This is ensign work. Maybe even cadet. On Orion, older pirates would haze new recruits by making them do worthless tasks, like clean the door panels with their tongues.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: You think Dirk's hazing us?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What's hazing?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It's a prank dressed up as team-building that nobody really likes.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well, that doesn't sound very Starfleet.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, I got to agree with Ruthie on this one. There is no way senior officers would haze a lieutenant.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: You're right. They have too much character.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What? No, no. They're not cool enough. This is just an annoying job, given to us by an annoying guy.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, I'm probably overreacting.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Hmm. Well, nothing seems to be wrong with your hardware. Do you mind if I take a look at your terminal?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Of course. Feel free to dig around.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah, I think I see the problem. Your operating system's out of date.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That would explain it. There was that weekend where my designers evolved into fifth-dimensional energy beings and left me on my own. When was my last update?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Six million and seven years ago.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah, that was a good year. Really good harvest season.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Huh. Hang tight, I'll get you caught up with this update, and it should clear things right up.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Thank you, Captain. You've saved us.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It'll be nice to get back to my old, helpful self af... af... after... after, after, after, after, after, after, after, after...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Vexilon?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: After, after, after, after, after...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Er, Captain? Did that update require a shutdown?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It wasn't supposed to.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: All right, gang. Just remember, the name of the game is safety.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Okay. Also hurry. Safety and speed.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Lieutenant, these power cylinders are extremely volatile. Are you certain speed is necessary?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Something's going on with the weather, and these guys are pros. They'll be... Taylor, what are you doing?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Er, reaching for the first clamp?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Love the initiative, but your angle is all off. I need 90 degrees, not 80. But no worries. I probably did a bad job explaining how deadly these bomb tubes are.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Okay.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Stop! Stop! Stop. You know what? Why don't I show you how to do one, then you guys can do the rest.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: But doesn't each one take three people, sir?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, no, no, no, you don't have to do that whole sir thing with me. I'm chill. Call me Bradward or Boims or something.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Doesn't this take three people, Bradward?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Technically, yes, but I think I should show you how to do it right, just on this first one. So you have four subsponders in the corners that interface with the ion generator in the center, which self-stabilizes the reaction. If broken in the wrong order, the container will explode, so you have to be careful as you remove each one... Got it. Then repeat that three times. Then you rotate the old cylinder until you feel the latch disengage, at which point you carefully remove it. Now, it's very important to keep it upright and lift with your knees, not your back, because you really don't want back pain, and that's why you put it in the taupe bin, and not the magenta bin. Got it?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I don't think we did.

line: Maybe we could try it?

line: Okay, not a big deal. Let me just pop another quick demo for you.

line: When are we going to get to do some of the mission?

line: Lancelot!

line: Ow! Hot! Ah! How many more of these things are there?

line: Rutherford's got the last couple.

line: You ever notice that it's always the last chip you test?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Just scan it.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No, that's not right.

line: But we tested every chip. Rutherford, make it make sense.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I can't. It has to be this one.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: How's it going in here, Lieutenants? Wow. You all look beat. Oh, didn't know scanning could be so taxing.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Argh!

line: Er sir, look, we've scanned every chip. They're all fine.

line: Hmm. Every chip? Even the second layer?

line: Why didn't you tell us about all these?!

line: I don't know. The hidden button seemed obvious. Anyway, these are twice as hot, so you'll want to use tongs, which makes it twice as hard.

line: Ah! Lancelot! Leave me alone! I don't have any meat!

line: Billups, I've got eyes on Lancelot.

line: The hidden button seemed obvious. Oh, this is definitely hazing. So much for character.

line: Ouch! Yeah, I think you're right. Hey, how'd you deal with this kind of thing back on Orion?

line: Blindfolded saber fight.

line: Okay, I wanna hear more about that, but I think I have a less stabby solution.

line: Okay, okay, no big deal. Just a frozen progress bar and some crazy day-night stuff. Now, I think the ancient manual is saying to press this?

line: Oh, yeah.

line: Ha-ha!

line: Oh.

line: Sorry, Captain. I'm... I'm having a hard time today. Lancelot got out when I was cleaning his snuggle tower, and I just... Wow! This is a classic setup. Is it a Unotronic? That... that kills in engineering.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Billups, this isn't the time for your computer comedy.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: And we're sure we want to turn it back on? It's not, like, crushing the will of the locals or anything?

line: We love Vexilon.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No. It's a nice one. We're fine.

line: Is it safe to jiggle his power source? I mean, you'd be surprised...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Safe. Excellent thinking, Commander. Ah ha! A lot of these ancient computers had a safe mode for debugging. Now, if I can just activate it... There. That got rid of the stalled update. Yeah.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Captain, are you sure this is safe mode and not a full reboot?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Er...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I am Vexilon. Welcome to your new world. I will now re-genesis installation to default settings. Initiating fjords. Distributing miasma. Stirring primordial ooze.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Doing one more myself should really teach you guys how to do this.

line: There's only one left.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Shouldn't we help? It's getting really crazy out there.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Just keep doing what you're doing!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We're not doing anything.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Lieutenant Boimler, your ensigns have a point. Leading by example has proven to be inefficient.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I only have one left, and we all get out of here alive.

line: Freeman to Lieutenant Boimler.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Go ahead, Captain.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Has your team finished the retrofit?
