line: We're almost finished here, sir.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Don't. I need you to put it back the way it was.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: But, Captain, it's getting pretty apocalyptic out here.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I know.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: According to this scroll we found in an ancient junk drawer, Vexilon can force a restart if we reroute its primary power to your station.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: But the station's outdated.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We have to get this done before the anaerobic bacteria is dispersed.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No problem. Just gonna quickly undo all the work I just did. Another learning experience for you. Uh oh.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Fascinating. A mountain or possibly a volcano has appeared. Ah. It is a volcano.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Are you sure we shouldn't just ask him to stop hazing us?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No, Mariner's right. Hazers only respect hazing.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That's why we trap him in the Wadi game, and let him marinate in there for a bit while the Betazoid gift box screams at him.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I guess he'll have to respect us after this. I know I would, and I already did.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Quick, let's get out of here.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Whoa.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, hey. Done already?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ha. Totally, my man.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No error'ed chips. All good to go.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, thank God. I can't tell you how glad I am to hear that.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, really? Why?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Those isolinear chips run some of the most important systems on the ship. If one fails, it could be fatal.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, but, not... like, not really?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes, really. Even one going down could be catastrophic. Thank you so much for taking that on. I really appreciate it.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Come on. If it was important, why wouldn't you have done it yourself?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I would have. I... Doctor Migleemo says acceptance is the road to healing. How familiar are you with the Wadi Chula game?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We put one in... I... I mean, the what now?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It's a game that traps a user in a little fucking dimension until they can complete its challenges. When I was a kid, I got trapped in one for a month. I was... too dumb to work my way out.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, no, you weren't dumb.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That experience, that torture, colored my life. I can't go near the anomaly room without having a panic attack because one of those games is on the ship. I should have helped you today, but all those glowing chips... remind me too much of the... Game. Oh, God.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, yes. Oh, thank you for sharing so much, and I am glad to be a part of your journey. You know, maybe, oh, would it cheer you up to talk about that music that you like so much?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Tellarite slop jazz?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes! Oh, yes, that's it. Okay, you've rambled about that at length before. Go fix it.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, I could go on about slop jazz forever. You know, everybody thinks the slops is about how much spit you can get to drip out of the nozzle...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Uh-huh, uh-huh.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: .but it's really about the brizzles flarps.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, you know, it sounds wet, and that is what I like. Please continue.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Sir, please let us help.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Stay away from the blast zone. Just five or six more trips. Oh. Look out!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: This is quite enough, Lieutenant. You will allow the ensigns to assist you.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: But I don't er...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Whoa!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: It is admirable that you care for the safety of your team, but danger is an accepted risk of Starfleet duty.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No, I know. It's not that.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: If you have not been acting in their defense, then what has caused your unpredictable behavior?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Last week I was an ensign with them, and now, randomly, I'm supposed to tell them what to do? What gives me the right to put my peers in a position where they could die?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Your promotion was not random. I studied your records and mission logs before our departure. The commander was correct to promote you. Your work is exemplary. Look at your team. They deserve your trust, just as Commander Ransom trusted you.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: They could all have greatness in them.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That remains to be seen, but if you do not order them to aid in the unloading of these power cylinders, we will all perish.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The files really said I'm great?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: They thoroughly describe your strengths and shortcomings.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: You're right. I have to let them do their jobs. T'Lyn says I got to put you guys in danger, so let's do this.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: That is not how I would have communicated the lesson.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Everybody up. We've worked together for years. I trust you. Big Merp, you're with me. We're unloading the transport. Taylor and Meredith, claim a terminal and get those power cylinders reattached. Nobody's exploding today.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: On it, sir.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes, sir.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Aah! Oh, no. Oh.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Fiddle-de-dah!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No, no, no, no, no!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, man, am I in the game?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Move along home. Allamaraine, count to four.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: But flizz bop is really more of a bastardisation of modal skuzz. Er, this isn't boring, is it?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Boring? What? - How could a musical lecture be boring?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Okay, so...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Allamaraine, then three more. Allamaraine, if you can see.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Faster, motherfucker.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Allamaraine, you'll come with me.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Later, little girl.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Best of them was probably Fats B'zirtak, but he overdosed on Ketracel-white.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah, that shit will mess you up.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: You have progressed to...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ha! Got your ass!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Which takes us up to 2380.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yeah. Yes.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well, I should probably get back to my room.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Migleemo's coming over to help me sort through my trust issues.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh. Wait! Don't you want to list some more stuff at me?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We can meet up after. This has been fun.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: This looks dangerous. Don't fall, Rutherford.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We got to!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Whoa! Wha...?!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What? Where am I? Was that an entire simulated life?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Sorry about that.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I miss my wife.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Wait, wait, wait, wait! Who are your top three sizzle horn players? Stop if you like music!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Dirk, wait! Someone told me there's no difference between slop jazz and skuzz blues!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What?! Whoever told you that is a fool. Oh, crap. I forgot. I'm meeting Migleemo in his office. Ha! I had no reason to come back here for hours.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Where are we at with those cylinders?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Complete!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Complete!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Securing my final clamp!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Taylor, Merp, assume the rotational stance.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ah! I got this.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Rotate... now! Captain, power's up!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Keep the engine running while I hack this megastructure.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: What happened? Oh no, did I shut down? Oh, I'm a terrible host.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Vexilon, focus. I need you to stop the planetary re-genesis before we all get killed.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes, of course. I'm so sorry. This is so embarrassing. Hey, give me a sec.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Great work, team. Now let's get on the shuttle before...

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Argh, the turbine's overheating!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Er, Captain, we've got a problem.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: We're almost done. I need more time.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Everyone out of here.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: No! We can help.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Ensign, the lieutenant gave you an order.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Okay, almost... there. Re-genesis is deactivating. Lieutenant Boimler, shut it down.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: On it, Captain.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Bradward, no!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The lieutenant junior grade first mission mortality rate... appears to be accurate.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Er... hi?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Aah! Get it off! Get it off me!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Holy shit, I can't believe that worked.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Did we complete the mission?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yes, you were the only fatality.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Yup, feels like it.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: The captain believes the updated operating system will keep the population safe for over a thousand years. Your mission was a success.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Well done, Mister Boimler. You never forget your first death. Only more and more dangerous missions from here on out.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, come on, I just revived him. Everybody out! Give me 30cc's of whatever just worked a fucking minute ago.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I am so glad we didn't get Dirk sucked into the game. The guy seems traumatized.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: He's working on it, though. Under that grouchy exterior is a guy just trying to find some peace.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: I wish he could find it without sending me all these jazz albums. I like them, and it's bugging me. I am not a jazz person.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, I feel silly, thinking a Starfleet officer would ever haze someone. Hmm. Sorry I ever brought it up.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Next time, we assume the best in people.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Hear! Hear!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: They bought the Wadi game story, huh?

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, yeah. Told them I was stuck in there for a month. Hey, little guy. Go get Rutherford.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Argh! Lancelot!

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Oh, new lieutenants give me life.

title: In the Cradle of Vexilon
line: Good weasel. Nice weasel. Argh! Oh!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm gonna get a big tattoo of a rusty chain, that goes from my leg and wraps around up my neck.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Urgh. You can't just get a tattoo of a chain. You've got to earn it.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I will when I take over a ship.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Come on, Risik. We deliver fuel and supplies to real pirates. We're, like, pirate adjacent.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Right now I'm just a plunder sorter, but I'm capable of way more.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Sure you are. Trash barrel.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hey, did you guys see that Maleer got big pieces of metal attached to her head?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No way.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: They look awesome. She shaved off her hair and now she has these, like, gnarly bolts sticking out.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Whoa! Maybe I'll get some of those, too.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: How about you get an original idea for once?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm stealing. Pirates steal.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, I think that makes you more of an Orion plagiarist.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Huh?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hailing frequency's open, Captain.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Small vessel, power down your engines and we will board you without violence.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We have dilithium to deliver. This will put us behind.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, hush, Z'oto. Let's have some fun for once. They're right there.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Captain, the vessel's speed is decreasing.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: See? This'll be a quick pillage.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: They're powering weapons!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Raise shields!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Power relays are failing!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Get them back online.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Trying to reroute power.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: How did they access our system?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: And... done! All the diseases blocked by the transporter biofilter after last week's shore leave, have been cataloged. Next up is... Nothing? That can't be right. There's always something to do.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Well, one of the great things about being a lieutenant JG is it's actually possible to finish your work.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We should do something fun!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Celebrating a lack of purpose is illogical.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hey, Ma. What up?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I have exciting news for Lieutenant Tendi. You've been granted leave to visit your family on Orion, effective immediately.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, wow. My family.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Apparently, your sister is getting married. Congratulations.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Wait. Wedding, sister, parents? Tendi, I... I'm sorry, I'm freaking out. This is more backstory than I have ever been able to get out of you.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, that's okay, Captain Freeman. I don't need to go. I mean, there's so much work to catch up on.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Starfleet is eager to demonstrate goodwill after the recent disappearance of an Orion ship.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, right. If it's to help Starfleet, I... I guess I could go.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Thank you, Lieutenant.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hey, you okay, D?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah. I... I just haven't been home in so long. Plus, they want me to be in the ceremony, which means writing a speech. Oh, and of course they'll want photos of all of us in our belly dancer outfits.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hmm. It is rare for outsiders to observe Orion rituals. May I accompany you on this mission? The High Council would find my report enlightening.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What? No! I mean, er, it's going to be super unenlightening, actually.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Come on, dude, T'Lyn's right. I mean, nobody knows anything about your culture. I have put my foot in my mouth enough when it comes to Orion stuff. We want to learn about the real you.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: But the real me is just gonna be doing a bunch of boring traditions.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Sounds awesome. Plus, I'm sorry, I just... I have to get away from Boims and Rutherford. Ever since they moved in together, they're, like, finishing each other's sentences.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Their emotional closeness is unpleasant.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't know.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Please, let me support my number one Orion amiga.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Okay, sure. Why not? Maybe it'll be good for you guys to see what my homeworld is actually like.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hell yeah. Triple threat girls' trip.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I hope we will be allowed to view their aquifers.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ooo, okay. T'Lyn getting rowdy.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ooo, love the new bedspread, roomie. Andorian linen?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You know it, roomie.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: So breathable.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: It's like grandmama Boimler used to say. A cool duvet keeps the raisin rats away.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Speaking of sleep, is there anything I can do to improve yours? I know sometimes I shift around when I'm engineering in my dreams.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Your squirming is so gentle, it actually lulls me to sleep faster.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Aw, roomie, your presence comforts me, too.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm so glad we ended up bunking together. Nothing can stop.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Brutherford!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Whoopsie-doopsie. I was just gonna give our bonsai here a little spritz.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, I was, too. Lil Boney loves a little watery hug in the morning.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I've got an algorithm which tells me exactly how many ounces Lil Boney needs for optimal health.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, yeah, but I've got a green thumb from growing up on a vineyard. You can't trust an algorithm for everything, right?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Give me the mister.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Nope.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Give it to me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Give it to me!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I said no, Mister Rutherford!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, I'm sorry. What? You grew up in a castle, like friggin' Billups?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Just a regular old Orion upbringing. No fancy stuff.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Halt!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hiyah!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Get in the shuttle. I'll hold them off while you guys get airborne.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Greetings, Mistress. May we take your bags?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hi, Syraa. Yes, please.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ooh, I am sorry about that.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ah, I think we can skip the sedan, if that's... Whoop!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: All right, we're getting lugged by the big boys. Tendi, I'm sorry, are you loaded?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, no. We're barely the fifth-largest family in the Syndicate.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Orions downplay their wealth, while simultaneously making a spectacle of it.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ha, ha. I mean, you don't have to put that in your report, do you?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Look, I am from a post-scarcity world, and this is still impressive. Look at that big-ass gate!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, n... I mean, it's not that big.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: D'Vana, my light in the dark. Welcome home. Mwah. Mwah.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mariner, T'Lyn, meet my parents, the Warrior Queen Shona and B'Rt.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: So, you do have Starfleet friends. I would say I've heard so much about you, but, well, Orions don't lie.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You don't?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No, we do all the time. I can't stay silent any longer. D'Vana, D'Erika's been kidnapped.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, what? No way. Bridal kidnappings are an Orion rite of passage.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hmm. Interesting.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm sure the rival family will make their demands soon enough.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Bah. Brides are only abducted after save-the-dates and before the invitations. This is far too late.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mom, you're overreacting.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: As Prime daughter it's up to you to rescue your sister.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What is a Prime?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't know, but it sounds cool as hell.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I concur.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You've turned your back on our traditions.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, so this wasn't an invitation. You just wanted me to rescue D'Erika.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Don't be dramatic. Of course it's nice to see you. There's also a box of stuff we want you to get out of the garage.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You have to save your sister.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Because you love her, or because this wedding's just an excuse to merge our house with another Syndicate family?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Obviously both.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Urgh! Fine.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I knew we could count on you. To the oil baths.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Wow, everyone here really loves getting carried around on platters.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Who's ready for a very standard, borderline boring Orion rescue mission?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Let's do it. And then after, maybe we do those oil baths I keep hearing about.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I've never asked you for anything!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: never asked you for anything, too.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ah! You misted me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: It just went off in my hand.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, we have the holodeck reserved. How about we go have some fun, and then after, maybe we'll get along better.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, what in the Sam Hill are you a-wearing? I thought I was supposed to be Twain.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I say you are incorrect, sir. I believe we decided I would be Twain.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Twin Twains? That dog won't hunt.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, Mister Clemens?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mmm-hmm. That's me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No, I'm Twain. Switch costumes, you ignominious pretender.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You're more stubborn than a Senate mule.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Grits, grits, grits!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tarnation!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Fancy pants, big-city lawyer.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I say you are incorrect, sir.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I fail to understand why we must wear this attire when we are clearly not Orions. The material is inefficient.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I know the uniform is more comfortable, but Slit Throat has a dress code.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You know, got to respect that they didn't even pretend to add a pun in there. It shows strength. I like it.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We're just gonna grab some info and be on our way.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Sure, but how the hell are we getting in there?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh... Let us in.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Get in line. Oh... Oh, Mistress of the Winter Constellations! Oh, I didn't realize! Please don't flay me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, he... he's just kidding. I would never flay.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I owe you an eternal debt of gratitude. My grandchildren will sing of this day.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tendi. Shame on you for not bringing me here before now. Are we gonna talk about how everyone's in awe of Tendi?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: She does command an unexpected gravitas for someone so excitable.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: It's on the house, Mistress. And that is from the Madame.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mariner!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: All good. Ah, I love it, actually. All part of the ambience.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Here for payback, D'Vana?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't know what you're talking about, Madame G. I'm just here looking for my sister.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Urgh. Bridal kidnappings are so gaudy. I thought the Tendis had class.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't care what you think, just what you know.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I've heard some whispers, but you'll have to earn them.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, please, can we not?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, has Starfleet softened you?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ah. Yes. I love being soft.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tendi, how are you so good at the murder-bug drinking game?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't know. It's my first time. Guess I'm just a natural.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Nya'al is still in love with D'Erika. Everyone knows it.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: So you're saying he's to blame?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Bridenappings are for show. But if it was Nya'al, D'Erika could really be in trouble. Let's get moving.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ah, let's get brunch while you're in town, girl.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, for sure. There is no way I'm calling her.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: And you, sir, are as clever as an alley cat on his tenth life.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I am but a humble crumb on the biscuit of your wit, sir.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I say, I can't believe two charming devils such as ourselves were ever at odds, my identical friend.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah. For some reason, when we're both Mark Twain, we seem to be able to really find common ground without any lingering resentment. I mean, er, to paraphrase the old rail-splitter, a house divided in Twain cannot stand.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Okey-dokey. It would be my honor if you would mist the bonsai on odd stardates, my doppleganging devil.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: And you, sir, shall have the evens.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Lieutenants Boimler and Rutherford, report to the bridge.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I say, we're on the way, sir.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Computer, arch.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Why are vests so complicated?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: So, er, Tendi, would you like to talk about how you totally whupped ass back there?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, yeah, sorry about that. High school friendships always age weird, you know? This next place will be way more chill.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Fascinating. Orions attend secondary education.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah. I wasn't going to get into Starfleet Academy because I can tie a lot of knots.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: How many knots can you tie?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er...

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hey, who cares? We've all tied some knots. Knots are fun.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ooh, pretty nice hump dungeon. I think they have one of these in New Seattle.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: These are pretty common on Orion.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: The males appear to be under some sort of chemical manipulation, perhaps controlled by pheromones.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Don't log that.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, Tendi's made it clear that Starfleet made those pheromones up. I mean, they had to explain why a captain would get taken out by some Orion showgirls.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, yeah, that's the stuff. Blast me with more 'mones.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Huh.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, technically, I said that not all Orions control men with pheromones. Some of us definitely do, just not me. Nya'al!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, fuck.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Get back here!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Nya'al's got some speed for being a big ol' hunk of ham steak.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: He is esthetically pleasing.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mistress, I swear I know nothing. I'm just a 'monehead. I spend all day and night hopped up on the stink.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: So what's gonna spill first, your mouth or your guts? Er, I heard that in a holo-movie.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: D'Vana? Why are you threatening one of my most obedient boys? Relax, have a drink, get lascivious.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm not interested in any of the sexy nonsense, Ingreeta. I'm here for D'Erika's ex.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Pity. The D'Vana I know would never turn down a cage shower.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ha. She's kidding. Tell them you're kidding.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: It never mattered that she didn't have the pheromones. She didn't need it. Men would simply fall at her feet, stricken.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You stricked people?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Are all pheromonal Orions naturally manipulative or is it specific to this woman?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: How dare you judge me, Vulcan?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, fuck. What are the odds? Are... are you seeing this?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You can't come into my scentuary and insult me. Prepare to face my thrall. Kill her.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tendi, look out for the hunks!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, man. Another pheromone dungeon?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Wh-What did you do to him?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Just a little compound I mixed up to counteract the effects of the pheromone. Would be a pity if I dispersed the whole bottle in here.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Don't! All I have is my stink. Nya'al, tell her what you know.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I've been a mess since D'Erika got engaged, but all I did was give myself over to the 'mones. Sometimes I follow her and watch wistfully from a distance. Last time, she was just wandering around the ship graveyard.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: All right, that makes sense. You're a good guy, Nya'al. You should go home.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I will.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Stop groveling. Lick my foot.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Dude, your 'stache.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ow.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: With all due respect, Coqqor, you have no claim to this sector. That nebula is ours to scan.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No. Your vessel will interfere with our data gathering.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We can power down systems or share the data.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We don't trust Starfleet data. It's too nuanced and thorough.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm sorry, but analyzing that nebula, is my mission.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Are you willing to die for it?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: If we can't resolve this, the nebula will phase shift and neither of us will get to scan it.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Then so it shall be!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Close channel. This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance to scan an oscillating nebula. There has to be something we can do to find common ground without any lingering resentment.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, Captain?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Er, there is one thing.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Why am I wearing this itchy hair hat?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Is this it?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No. You have to talk to each other.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Thank you, Captain, for agreeing to do... this.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No, you have to do the accent.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I say, uh, uh, uh, uh, my... my good creature, er, the moral arc of history is a m... Oh, what the hell am I supposed to say, Lieutenant?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Homespun aphorisms about compromise.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Okay, uh, maybe you try that in a Southern accent.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I am from South Chalnoth. That was a Southern accent.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What the hell made you two think this would work?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We... we were arguing a lot and we both dressed like Mark Twain.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Something about us talking old-timey helped us figure out who should water our bonsai.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What is bonsai?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, oh, watch out. There's a loose panel over there.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Curious. You seem familiar with this location, yet it appears to be abandoned.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: D'Erika and I used to sneak away here when we were little. There! That was one of our favorites.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I loved pretending I was off-planet, exploring space. Doing anything other than pirating. Guys, I have to come clean about something. I wasn't just a regular Orion teenager. I was trained to be a Syndicate assassin.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tendi, yeah, we know, girl. You can't just say you're joking around when you kick-flip a knife out of the air.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Your upbringing was quite obvious.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I just hate that you guys had to see the real me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Tends, the real you is the one who geeks out about science on the Cerritos.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: But I'm a Prime, you know? A... a trained assassin. It's... it's the most piratey someone can be.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Incorrect. You are who you choose to be. A Starfleet lieutenant and a loyal friend.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Don't worry, we know you're a big nerd and not some hot assassin.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, that is the nicest thing anyone's ever said to me. It's so weird to be here. This is where I told my sister that I was joining Starfleet.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: More like where you decided to abandon your family.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: D'Erika?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hey, we did it. Case closed.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You kidnapped yourself.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Wow, did Starfleet teach you those amazing detective skills?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Was this just to get me to show up for the wedding? I would have just come.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Classic D'Vana. Always assuming it's about you.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ha, ha. Nope. I'm gonna stand way over here.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Fascinating, Orions primarily resolve disputes through violence.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: No, no, that is not true. D'Erika, please, can we just talk about this?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'll let my blade do the talking.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, come on!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: D'Erika, don't stab my friends!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: What are you gonna do about it?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Teach you how to respect your Prime.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yes, yes. Beautiful.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We love it, too. Super hard to raise.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, he's basically a son to us. Every day we have to make sure he gets just the right amount of...

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Now I'm thirsty for mist.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I'm sated. You may inspect the nebula. But pray I don't change my mind.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yes, yes, you are very intimidating.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Thank you.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Lil Boney.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I don't get it. Why do this? Why kidnap yourself?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Because I knew it was the only way to get you to come home.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You didn't invite me.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, would you have even come? You haven't been home once since you left.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, I've kind of been busy.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Hiyah! With what? Scanning? Why is Starfleet so obsessed with scanning?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: To learn stuff!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You abandoned me for science.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Don't.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You were trained from birth to be the Tip of the Moonlit Blade, the greatest duty of the Mistress of the Winter Constellations.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I didn't ask for that.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Neither did I. You forced this on me without asking. Running to Starfleet was your choice, but it meant all your duties fell on me. I had to train, I had to be the Mistress. I had to drop my whole life to become the new Prime.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You're right. I should have talked to you before I left instead of just assuming you'd want to take my place. I'm sorry.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Of course I wanted to take your place. But I'm no D'Vana Tendi. Once I'm married, people are going to see that I'm a pale comparison.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Are you kidding me? The only reason I felt comfortable leaving was because I knew you would be better at it than me. You just kicked my butt. You're an amazing Prime.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I guess I did kick it a little bit.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: A lot a bit. D'Erika, I always loved science. That was my path. This is yours.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, lady, if you're worried about not being a badass, I have some good news for you.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I, too, was alarmed by your combat abilities.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You really think I can do this?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: You absolutely belong on the Crime Throne.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: That means a lot. Oh! What time is it?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: The bridal procession is scheduled to begin in under two hours.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We are never going to make it back in time.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I might not be a pirate, but I've rerouted my fair share of EPS conduits. Who wants to hotwire a stolen ship?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I do not.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, stop, stop, stop. We're in.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: See? Sometimes being an Orion pirate isn't so bad.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, it does come in handy. I know you're turning in your observations to the High Council, but maybe could you leave off some of the stabbings?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Curious. My report appears to have been damaged. Orion culture will have to remain undocumented.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: But... why?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: A report without the subject'sconsent would be unethical.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, no!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: I think the plasma manifold just ruptured.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: We're losing altitude. The goddess chooses our fates now!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Mom, Dad, found her!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Sorry, sorry, had to steal a ship.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Oh, my special girls. Accomplices.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ah, he looks radiant.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: That's when I got stabbed in the shoulder during the daddy-daughter dagger dance.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: This is when we encountered a priest with an eight-pack.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Ooo, ooo, ooo! And, er, this is when D'Erika swung her husband across the threshold.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, well, our bonsai got gobbled up by a Chalnoth.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, yeah, and the captain forbid us from playing Mark Twain on the holodeck.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Are you guys jealous? Oh, it was just a wedding.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Why would we ever want to go to an awesome pirate wedding on a planet nobody ever gets to see?!

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Aw, sorry you can't release some of this anger with Mister Clemens.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Shockingly, it's not the universal problem solver we thought it was.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, but we've got it covered. Ooo, like today we were arguing about whether to hang an oil painting of the Enterprise-D or watercolor of the Enterprise-D.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Well, you guys just talked about your feelings with honesty, right?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Yeah, I guess we could try that.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Shall we go with an acrylic of the D, Mozart?

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: An exceptional compromise, Mozart.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Then let us tickle the ivories.

title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
line: Dang. This thing is really hard to play.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Outgoing communication. Provisional Lieutenant Junior Grade T'Lyn to Captain Sokel of the VCF Sh'vhal. Due to the recent unprovoked attacks on ships across the quadrant, the USS Cerritos is providing transport to three Betazoid diplomats. These glorified socialites just spent three weeks attending parties on Angel 1 and now intend to, quote, keep the good times rolling as we escort them to Risa. Despite the crew's enthusiasm, I find the Betazoids' exuberance... disruptive.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, I love your Starfleet carpeting. It's perfect to pass out on.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: It's an honor escorting you to Risa.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Thank you, Captain, but I can sense that you feel babysitting us isn't your favorite mission.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh no. No, no, no. I'm proud to...

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Shuttle a bunch of sexy drunks around?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Katrot's just giving you a hard time. We appreciate the lift.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Particularly on a ship with such sturdy officers.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: That's what I'm talking about. I get off bridge duty at 1300 hours.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Yuck, never mind. I like it when they're hard to get.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, come on, give me another chance. I can be distant and unavailable.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Prrr. Now, this is a woman who seems withholding.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, er, well, flattered, but I'm happily married.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Is he on the ship?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Er...

line: Cathiw, we've been here for five minutes. Let's maybe check out our rooms before you devour someone.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Whoa. Hello.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I'll devour whoever I want, Dolorex, you sanctimonious buzzkill.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Not to worry. We've been ordered to make sure you have a good time. Let's top off those whalebones, shall we? Lieutenant?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, I'll take another yard of anything glowing and green. Thank you.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: My posting here is usually trying, but never more than now. I feel it necessary to relay the severity of my circumstances.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: This is sickbay. Hangover cures, prophylactics, well, it's all available right here.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Ah. I didn't realize there was going to be a buffet today.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Buffet? I wasn't informed of any...

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: She's joking. In the ancient past, Caitians used to hunt and eat Betazoids.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh! Well... Doctor T'Ana, these are our guests. Don't you consume anyone.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, don't worry, that was centuries ago. Now we only eat synthetic Betazoid.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Ow!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Enough with the tour already. As this amazing hat I bought from some gal on Angel 1 says, It's Romulan ale o'clock somewhere. You guys have a bar around here?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Why, yes. Oh, no need for those, Lieutenant. We're already heading for more cocktails.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Time to get to surgery. Whoa,

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: The Betazoids' attitudes have inspired many in the crew to get the party started. Such infectious frivolity would never be tolerated on a Vulcan ship. If reinstated, I will suppress my own chaotic tendencies. It is only logical for my punishment to conclude and that I return to the Sh'vhal.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Hey, T'Lyn, you coming to this Betazoid party? I know you don't drink, but there's gonna be a chocolate fountain if you want to get wild.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I do not understand what you mean, but thank you for the invitation.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, yeah, good luck getting a message out right now. We're in full security blackout. No outgoing comms while the 'Zoids are on board.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: No communications, and yet alcohol and merrymaking are permitted? Everything about this ship is illogical.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Yeah, totally. Well, if you change your mind, we'll be getting champagne-fully buzzed in the bar. Come hang.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Manhaver. Federov. Honus. Kayshon. Taylor. Merp. Big Merp. Er... er, starts with an S. Damn it! Sleepy Merp. How could I forget that? I'm such an idiot.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Hey, pal, ease up. That's my friend you're calling an idiot.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Yeah, well, that's what I am when I can't remember every single crew member's name.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Ooo, you're being pretty hard on yourself, Boims. Why don't you take a break and come to the Betazoid party?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I can't. I'm a lieutenant junior grade. I can't just go around not knowing everything.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: So then you'll have to know this party, or you'll be missing out.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Nice try, but I'll come if I memorize everyone. Then I'll have earned it.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Lieutenant Shaxs? I think I have a candidate for... the program.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: It would be illogical to attempt to send this message again. However, it would be logical to inquire when communications will reopen.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: She said I was too into it, and she shrugged me off. It's like, could she not see these gains?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Urgh! I said regurgitated soup, you stupid fucking replicator. This barely even tastes like it's been in my mother's mouth!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, my God, isn't this party the best? I love everyone and everything! Yeah!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: T'Lyn!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Yes, you came! Whoo! This fucking rules. Yes. Holy shit, fuck, yeah. Did you send your message?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: No. I am here to ask if there is an estimate to when communications will be back online.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: You came to talk to me?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: If you can resolve my query, then yes.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I've dreamed about this moment!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: It is not a moment.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Usually you're giving me a friendship bracelet or we're getting matching tattoos, but I'm still so happy!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Okay, D, calm down. Wait, is everyone getting weird all of a sudden? Why am I yelling?!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: This crew is always weird and yelling.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Yeah, baby, 'cause we're number one!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Enjoy hell, replicator.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: But perhaps you are correct, there do appear to be more emotional outbursts than I have previously observed.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Wow, Captain Freeman, I didn't know Starfleet had this kind of party in them.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: We don't. People, you are Starfleet officers. Pull it together and stop embarrassing me in front of the Betazoids. I want them to think we're cool.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: This is as controlled as I can get!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: We can't stop the party now, it's just getting started! I'm gonna drop us out of warp so we don't get to Risa too soon.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: What? No, Ensign Barnes, stop right there!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Boo!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Hey, just stop that! You can't boo your captain. Good God. Why do I even care? This isn't right. Something must be affecting us.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Huh, how have I never been to this part of the ship before? It's so quiet over here.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Easy, baby bear. I just want us isolated from any... interruptions.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh God, what am I gonna learn? Tsunkatse?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Worf. Worf, Worf. Torn between worlds. A warrior. No, a farm boy.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Hope you can handle slam poetry, Lieutenant.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: The son of Mogh, clang goes the bat'leth against the armor of your heart!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Why won't anyone listen to me? I'm the captain, damn it!

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I say we lock all these fools in the brig until they calm the fuck down, including me.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Chug, chug, chug, chug, chug, chug, chug, chug, chug...

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Captain, I believe it is plausible that the heightened emotional state of the crew is being caused by our guests.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: The Betazoids? No way. They're so nice. Dolorex? She said I'm hot.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: You frigging are. I got a hot mom.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, thank you, sweetie. I tried something new with my hair.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Zanthi fever is known to infect Betazoids of their age. It causes empathetic abilities to unintentionally broadcast, heightening the emotions of those around them.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Wow, okay, yes, that does kind of sound exactly like what's happening.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Perhaps if we opened communications, we could contact a Betazoid doctor.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: We can't risk that. Are you crazy? Sorry, what I mean is, Doctor T'ana will have to handle it herself.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: I am unsure of her current efficacy.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Well, if it isn't the most eligible captain in Starfleet. Hey, is it just me or is it incredibly horny in here?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Still married. Would you ladies mind joining me in sickbay? My provisional lieutenant thinks you're telepathically ill.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: That is not how I would have stated it, but the captain is accurate.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Telepathically ill? What the hell is she talking about?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: She's on to us. We need to do something.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Stand down. Let's see where this leads.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: We'd be happy to move this party to sickbay, as long as we can take our drinks.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: This morsel... I mean Betazoid... is deliciously pathogen-free.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Pathogen? What are you scanning for?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, just standard stuff. Goronian measles, Alterian flaking, Zanthi fever...

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Zanthi fever?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Listen, we're all gals of a certain age here. It's nothing to be embarrassed about.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: We're not old enough to be affected by Zanthi fever.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Oh, this is just an excuse to lock us up.

line: Cathiw's right. Our cover's blown.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: What is wrong with you two? Get a hold of yourselves. Remember your training.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: You remember yours. We need to act.

line: Well, that's all of 'em. No Zanthi fever detected.

line: Wonderful. What say we get back to the festivities?

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: You're not going anywhere.

title: Empathological Fallacies
line: Darling, what's the matter?

line: Captain, these diplomats are our guests.

line: Are you telling me it's just a coincidence that you three showed up right when my crew started losing their minds?

line: Captain, they scanned clear.
