line: And now he's taken one of my officers. If we move fast, we can still track his warp trajectory.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Unfortunately, there's no moving fast in a situation like this.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What situation?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Locarno has coordinated mutinies on ships from over a dozen non-Federation planets. If we did something that injured a Klingon or a Romulan...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: They turned their backs on their worlds when they moved against their captains.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: In bloodless coups.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We can't be the first to open fire. Now, we're already communicating with ambassadors from the worlds that have been tangled in this. I'm ordering both of you to stand down. Until this is sorted, we can't risk igniting a war.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Urgh! We're running out of time!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, nice ship. Very... white and... er... nothing else.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Thanks. I designed it myself. None of the Starfleet carpets or wood paneling in here. I can't tell you how much of a game changer it is to have a Starfleet officer join our cause. Imagine the looks on their faces when Command finds out an admiral's daughter defected.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ha, ha. Hell yeah. Let's stick it to those chumps. And how exactly are we sticking it to those chumps, by the way?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, don't worry. Everyone's about to find out.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Very cool. Not ominous at all.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What up, Bynars?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Open a subspace channel. All bands quadrant-wide. How do I look?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Confident, but, you know, like in a creepy way.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Perfect. That's what I'm going for.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Captain, we're picking up a transmission. It's going out on all channels.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: On screen. Mariner!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hello, Alpha Quadrant. Independent Captain Nick Locarno here with a message for anyone who feels like an afterthought.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: He looks like Tom Paris.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I don't see it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You may have been told scary stories of ships being destroyed these past few months, but that was a lie. They weren't destroyed, they were liberated. They're part of the first totally independent, unaligned fleet in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, the Maquis would like a word.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: If you're tired of risking your life for soulless bureaucratic captains who don't even know your name, if you fear following the orders of incompetent commanders who failed into seats of power, if you're stuck on the lower decks, then I invite you to join us in the Detrion system.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: They have, like, the same face. They're identical.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No, I just don't see it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Detrion, a forgotten system now protected by my indestructible Trynar Shield.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Geesh, why is he so mad?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Locarno was kicked out of Starfleet. He got one of his squad killed performing a banned flight maneuver, then tried to cover it up.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Clearly, his emotional behavior conflicts with his culpability.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yeah, he's an asshole.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: And in case anyone wants to try and force their way in, I've acquired a little insurance. A black market Ferengi Genesis Device.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Those can rewrite the atomic composition of entire worlds.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: He could wipe out life on any planet he chooses.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The man has lost his mind.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The Federation, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Empire, everyone has to respect Nova Fleet. Speaking of, I have an officer here who knows how to speak truth to power. Beckett, care to tell them what Starfleet's really like?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, er... Hey. What up, everyone? I have an important message for all you lower deckers out there. This guy sucks!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: He's an idiot and his plan is stupid. He's gonna get you all killed 'cause he only cares about himself.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Somebody stop her. End that transmission!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Attagirl. Cerritos crew, this is the captain. I am about to disobey a direct order and stage a rescue of Lieutenant Junior Grade Mariner. Now, I can't ask any of you to join me. If we survive,the court-martial is guaranteed, but, I will be damned if I wait for politicians to decide her fate.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm with you, Captain.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We all are.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Let me at 'em!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Let's fuck shit up.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You know I'm with you.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I believe the only response in this situation is... Cerritos strong.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: All departments checking in. Everyone wants to help.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Thank you. Now, we just have to figure outhow the hell we're getting past that damn shield.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I think I can help with that.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Beckett, you just made us look like a joke in front of the quadrant.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Kind of my entire plan.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What? Stop her.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, Computer, cycle airlock.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ah!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: All right, you are my first officer. Yay. My little buddy. Please, no exploding. Computer, command code override, er... 06107.2?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Welcome, Captain Carol Freeman.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yes! I knew that would come in handy. Transfer system controls to the command panel.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: How did she even get the engines online?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: It doesn't matter. Destroy it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No. Without the Genesis Device, the captains you betrayed will find a way to get through our shields. But that's okay, Romulans are famously forgiving. Right?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We have to stop her!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: How dare you, sister? Bringing these Starfleet outsiders here, shaming our house.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ms. Tendi, if you'll only let me explain...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, stand down, Captain. You have no authority here. I know this looks bad, but wouldn't you like to embarrass Starfleet with a show of strength? We're here against orders. Helping us will make them look weak.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hmm. That does sound enticing. I've never heard of a Trynar Shield. Just destroy it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No can do, Tendi Two. The Cerritos just doesn't have the weapons for it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We need a ship with enough firepower to punch a hole. We'd just be borrowing it, really. We'll give it right back.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, it's a warship, not a used copy of Sword and Scabbard.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I know, it's a big ask, but I wouldn't have come to you if it wasn't an emergency. This guy has my friend, D'Erika.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm overseeing the merger of two massive criminal enterprises. I can't collude with the Federation right now. Sorry, sis.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We understand, Mistress D'Erika. We thank you for your consideration. We'll have to find another...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I demand Barter By Combat!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ah! All right, G.D., let's hope this old tub can make it to warp.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Com... Computer, what the hell?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Proximity alert.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, shit.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Shields at 90%.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: My Trynar Shield works both ways. It keeps ships out and in.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yeah, I guess it slipped my mind because the name is so stupid. Oh, the three Bynars, right. Can you have three Bynars?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Look, why don't you just dock at the station? If you really don't want to join me, I'll send you on your way.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: And let you get your hands on a planetary murder machine? Er, no thanks.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm offering you the chance of a lifetime. You could be part...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Nope.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The rules of Barter By Combat are simple. Each side selects a warrior. If yours defeats mine, I'll lend you a battleship. But if you lose, your captain will surrender the Cerritos to me.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Deal.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: She's like a Shaxs-and-a-half. Are you sure we have anyone who can take her?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh yeah, we've got this. The Cerritos champion will be...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ah, you like that?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Doctor Migleemo.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Come on, come on. I need somewhere to hide. Ooo, dangerous and unpredictable space debris. Hang on, G.D. This is gonna be rough.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The human has target lock. Aiee!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What are you guys doing working for a jerk like Locarno? He doesn't care about profit at all.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: That means more profit for us.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What about Rule of Acquisition 91? "Your boss is only worth what he pays you."

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Locarno is not our boss. We make our own decisions.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: And you're forgetting rule 289. Shoot first, count profits later.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Computer, vent coolant vapor.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Bah! Our sensors are ruined. We've lost her.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Please, madam, perhaps we can settle this over a delicious bowl of slime. Whoa!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm gonna have to start over with a new therapist, aren't I?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: She's going to kill him.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Doctor Migleemo, fluff your down. Fluff your down!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: It's embarrassing.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Just fluff it!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Bless you, dear. Wait, what's happening?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I used to train with B'eth. She has really bad allergies.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh-ho! Accept my flappity fisticuffs, you foul fiend. Kyah! Kyah! Ew! The snot.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The champion of Barter By Combat is B'eth. Somebody get her her inhaler. A deal's a deal, Captain. The Cerritos is mine. Transfer your ship's control codes, Captain, or our swords will get considerably bloodier.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: A deal's a deal, but, you must know Locarno was only out for himself. He's attacked your kind as well.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, I'll deal with him in my own time.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Wait. I have something you want more than the Cerritos.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm a pirate queen, sister. What would I want more than a ship?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Me.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Tendi, what are you doing?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Look, you've wanted the Mistress of the Winter Constellations back working for the family for years. If you give us a battleship, I'll come back.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Tendi, you can't...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Silence! Having you back at my side would mean more than some measly support ship.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: The Cerritos is not measly. She is the gem of the Calif...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Andy, shut up.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You have a deal, sister. We have an Orion destroyer for your rescue. But, I expect you to return here even if you fail to save your friend.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We won't.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Damn, warp drive's out, life support's damaged. I hate to say it, but, I think I got to set you off somewhere, before anyone catches up. Sorry, buddy. Computer, are there any lifeless planets in this system?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Detrion 9 is incapable of supporting life.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Well, sounds like a party. Plot a course.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Whoa, look at the size of that thing.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Er, Captain, we have a problem.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Urgh! Get me that Orion.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Captain Freeman. A pleasure to speak again so soon.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: This warship is totally inoperable. You said you were going to help us.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I said I would lend you the Retribution. We never discussed its condition.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: This isn't fair!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No. But it is extremely Orion. See you soon, D'Vana.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Billups, report.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: This thing's a relic. Half the systems are fried. It could take months to get it battle-ready.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We don't have months.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Don't worry, Captain, I've got my best team working on it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We could skip life support. Maybe reroute the shields.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We need to disassemble the warp drive, not to mention the conduits.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Who cares about the conduits, Livik? We should focus on firepower and engines.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You can't just activate some systems. They're dependent.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: They don't have to be!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Guys, we need to get on the same page.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I believe I can facilitate that.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh, oh my gosh. Are you gonna do a mind meld?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Something less invasive.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Well, I'll be happier than a milkman's horse. You know what you're talking about, Mister Livik.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: And you are a heapin' helpin' of country-fried intellect, my genteel friend.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I do declare, we've settled upon a compromise.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Why does this work?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Illogical tactics can sometimes lead to logical solutions.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: It's beautiful.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What the hell is that?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: A level seven ion storm. Recommend an alternate heading, or damage will occur.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, fucking Romulans!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Starfleet swine! Cease your pathetic attempts to flee and hand over the Device.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Huh, never thought I'd see Romulans taking orders from a human.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We do not take orders. Locarno's given us the freedom to scheme at our leisure.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, so you need a human for your scheming, huh? You can't do it on your own?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: That's right, Mariner. It may be hard for you to believe, but we are a coalition of equals. One that has you surrounded. That storm is only getting worse. Power down engines and we can start over without any...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hey, stop! What are you doing? That storm will rip you apart. Aw, damn it!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What are you worried about? We're fine. She won't last ten minutes in there.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Then we'll lose our bargaining power. Argh. Get in there and get that Device.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm sorry, are you giving me an order?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I thought we were a coalition of equals.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We can still profit without a Genesis bomb.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We need to be powerful! You cowards. I'll do it myself.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, this is getting old, Beckett.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hand over the Device before we get ripped apart.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Woo, he is obsessed with you, girl.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Nick, I know why you hate Starfleet, and it isn't because you have some deep connection with junior officers. You're pissed because you got booted from the Academy.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I am not. I've read your file. I hate command structure just like you.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No, I... I don't always agree with orders, sure, but I believe in the mission.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What about Sito? She died for no reason.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: She gave her life for what she believed in. You can't take that from her.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I thought you were smarter than everyone else. Sounds like you're just another apologist for a broken system.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hey, Starfleet's not perfect. They mess up all the time. But in the end, they're trying to do what's right. I didn't take a single shot at your fleet, but you put them in danger. And what about Josh?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: That wasn't my fault! If... if my stupid professors had just let us practice...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Josh died because of your ego, man.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Locarno, something just appeared outside the system. It's an Orion destroyer, and it's massive.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: This is it, people. We only get one shot. Are you ready, acting captain?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I've got this, but I want you back to take command when you're done.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You and me both.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Really good captain voice.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Thank you.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Cerritos, I ordered you to... Hey, who the hell are you?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Acting Captain Bradward Boimler, sir.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Turn that ship around right now.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yes, sir. But first I have to rescue my friend.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You can't get through that shield.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm not. Captain Freeman is.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Wh... what?

line: Helm, take us to full impulse. I need everything we've got.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Approaching the barrier, Captain.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Wait for it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Structural integrity's failing, sir.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Maximum impulse. The captain's counting on us. Wait for it... Now!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No, no, no, no, no. No!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Full impulse, before it closes.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Wow, I've never actually seen someone use the captain's yacht.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I do declare.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You said the shield was impenetrable.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I didn't know they were gonna throw a battleship at it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: This is a disaster. We have to get out of here.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No, stand firm. You have to follow my orders. This is my plan, and my system. Huh?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Urgh! Damn Bynars.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Then you can stay here on your own.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Go ahead and run. I don't need any of you. Yes! Finally. Nowhere else to hide, Lieutenant.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Whoa!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yes!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Sorry, girl, looks like I got to take you off the field right here.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Explosive terraformation will initiate in five minutes.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Huh, Ferengi bomb with a Ferengi voice. Didn't expect that, but, I like it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Get away from my Genesis Device.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: It's too late, Nick. I started the countdown, all right? We have to clear out of here.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh please. I graduated top of my class. You think I don't know how to disarm a bomb?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: First off, you didn't graduate. And second... that thing is too dangerous for anyone.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I could have been the best pilot in Starfleet.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Don't let that anger define your life. You stunned all those crews, you didn't kill them, because deep down you're not a murderer.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm sorry, but I really am. My perfect life was taken from me, and now I'm getting it back.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I'm not moving, Nick.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Then you're a fool.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Mom? How did you get through the shield?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We threw a battleship at it. Get us out of here.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No. We have to save Locarno.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: He's reactivated the shields. I can't get a lock.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Nick, please come with us.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Mirab, with sails unfurled.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We're out of time.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Please, Nick!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Full impulse, now.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Ha! Next time set a shorter timer.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: To deactivate detonation, please insert two bars of latinum.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: They put a paywall on a bomb?! Stupid Feren...

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: You willfully disregarded Starfleet orders.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: And I am prepared to take full responsibility for my actions, sir.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I should have you charged with insubordination, but you managed to open diplomatic relations with the Orions for the first time. Everyone at Command is... pleased with your work.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Thank you, Admiral. And if I may ask, what happened to the alien officers who allied with Locarno?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I imagine they're in hiding. Since there were no shots fired, Starfleet avoided repercussions. Oh, now we have to deal with the new M-Class planet that formed when the Genesis Device exploded.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Is it stable?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Seems so. We're calling it Locarno, because his atoms were included in the transmogrification of the nebula. We hope to use the planet someday as a home for refugees.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Then I guess he did some good after all.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: There is one last piece of business, regarding your lieutenant.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Mariner!

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Hey, easy. I didn't survive a Genesis explosion just so I could get hugged to death.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: We're just really happy you're back.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Thanks, Boims. I feel like I really am back for the first time in a while. I've been kind of all over the place the past few months. I was processing some heavy stuff, and, taking it out on everyone else. I'm sorry.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Apology not accepted. Because we're here for you no matter what.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Yeah, I think I have a handle on it now. You know, I might even try not self-sabotaging for once. I'll see how that goes.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Huh, that sounds remarkably healthy.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Okay, everybody shut up, me included. Let's get drunk.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, thank God. There you are.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Livik.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Rutherford.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Wait, I thought you guys liked each other now.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: No, no, no. Only when we're Twaining.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Perhaps you need to work on your leadership skills, Mister Rutherford.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh boy. Someone's got captain fever.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh, do I sound "captainy" to you? Because Ransom was very happy with my captaining.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: I like how this has in no way gone to your head. You know what, Boims? I think this is really working for you. This is a good look. You should tell my mom you want captain's lessons.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Really? You think she'd do that?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Who was that?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: My former commander, Captain Sokel.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: What?! But what if he wanted you to return to the Vulcan fleet?

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: After today's events, I'm sure he did. But instead, I prefer to focus my time on becoming your science bestie.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Oh! Don't you say that if you don't mean it.

title: Old Friends, New Planets
line: Why would I say anything I do not mean?
